The curtain is machine washable, which makes regular cleaning simpler than with bathroom textiles that require hand washing. Measure your tub or shower opening before hanging it, so you can confirm that the 70 by 72 inch size will cover the space as you intend.

record.description: A women's slingback sandal in amber, sized 7 medium. The upper is made of man-made or natural cork and closes with an adjustable hook-and-loop strap. The footbed was designed by a podiatrist and the strap has metallic accents.
record.seo_title: Vionic Gold Cork Women's Slingback Sandal
record.meta_description: Vionic Gold Cork women's slingback sandal in amber, size US 7 medium, with a podiatrist designed footbed, an adjustable strap, and an APMA seal.
record.long_description:
This slingback sandal from Vionic pairs a cork-look upper with supportive construction. The upper is listed as man-made or natural cork, and the strap has metallic detailing that adds a bit of shine. Four points of adjustment let you set the fit, which the seller says makes the sandal suitable for all day wear.

Inside, the footbed is wrapped in microfiber over an EVA base, and the brand says a podiatrist designed it. The listing states that the sandal has received the APMA Seal of Acceptance from the American Podiatric Medical Association. The outsole is rubber.

This pair is listed in women's size 7 medium, and the color is amber. The strap closes with hook-and-loop, so you can tighten or loosen it without tools. The listing focuses on design and support, so if you usually wear a different width, compare your fit before ordering.

specs.use: Practice, school PE, and backyard games

record.description: A ten pin plastic bowling set made for practice, school physical education, and backyard games. Each pin has a capped hole where sand can be added to keep the pins steady on uneven ground. A set-up sheet and a score pad are included.
record.seo_title: Champion Sports Plastic Bowling Pin Set, 10 Pins
record.meta_description: Champion Sports 10 pin plastic bowling set for practice and kids games. Pins have capped holes for sand weight, and a set-up sheet and score pad are included.
record.long_description:
This ten pin set is meant for practice and casual play, whether you are learning the game or looking for something to do in the yard. The pins are plastic and white, and ten is the number used in standard bowling, so the setup mirrors a real lane. Each pin has a small capped hole that takes sand for extra weight, which helps the pins stay upright on grass or a slightly uneven surface.

The set suits a range of players. Teachers can use it in school physical education classes, and families can host a backyard game for children and adults. The listing says it works for men, women, boys, and girls, and it suggests the set for parties or trips.

A set-up sheet shows how to arrange the pins, and a score pad is included so players can track results across a round. The equipment is described as usable on several surfaces, which gives it a broad range of places to play. The listing covers the pins and sheets, not bowling balls, so check whether you already have a ball before you start.

specs.includes: Jacket, trousers, mock shirt, and hat
specs.safety: Listed as meeting EU and American standards

record.description: A men's large Day of the Dead costume in black, themed under the name Señor Bones. The set includes a jacket, trousers, a mock shirt, and a hat. Chest, waist, and inseam measurements are included to help with sizing.
record.seo_title: Smiffys Men's Day of the Dead Señor Bones Costume
record.meta_description: Smiffys men's Day of the Dead Señor Bones costume in black, size large, with jacket, trousers, mock shirt, and hat. Chest 42 to 44 inches.
record.long_description:
This costume is a complete men's outfit themed around the Day of the Dead, sold under the name Señor Bones. The black set covers the look from head to toe with a jacket, trousers, a mock shirt, and a hat, so there is no need to source separate pieces for a themed event.

The sizing is men's large, with a listed chest measurement of 42 to 44 inches, a waist of 36 to 38 inches, and an inseam of 33 inches. These figures come from the listing and are the best guide for choosing this size. If your measurements fall between sizes, compare them with the listing before ordering.

The seller describes itself as a costume supplier with a long history in fancy dress, wigs, make up, and accessories. The listing says the products are tested to meet EU and American safety standards and arrive in branded packaging. These are seller claims, so review them alongside the sizing details when deciding whether this costume fits your plans.

record.description: A full spectrum LED light for aquariums about 46 to 54 inches wide, with an aluminum shell and two extendable brackets. It offers a colorful daylight mode and a blue lunar mode for night. The power adapter accepts 100 to 240 volts input.
record.seo_title: JOYHILL 48in Full Spectrum Aquarium LED Light
record.meta_description: JOYHILL full spectrum aquarium light for 46 to 54 inch tanks, with an aluminum shell, extendable brackets, and daylight and lunar modes. Includes a 12V adapter.
record.long_description:
This aquarium light is built for a tank roughly 46 to 54 inches wide, and it uses two extendable brackets so you can fit it across the top. The LED bar uses 2835 LEDs in a full spectrum mix of white, blue, red, and green, and it runs on a 12 volt adapter rated at 38 watts. The shell is aluminum alloy, which the listing describes as lightweight and durable.

The light has two modes. The colorful mode mixes the four LED colors for daytime viewing, and a blue lunar mode gives a soft nighttime glow. The listing says it suits fish-only tanks as well as tanks with plants or corals, and notes that many fish-only setups need little more than standard lighting.

The listing includes setup warnings. The light is meant to rest on a glass aquarium cover or an acrylic top, and it should not be used over open water. It also suggests several water changes before adding new lighting, and it recommends running the light for about 8 to 10 hours a day. The package includes the light, two brackets, and a power supply.

record.description: A black checked large spinner suitcase with a softside shell of ballistic nylon. It can expand by about 2 inches, holds about 143.5 liters, and rolls on eight magnetic wheels. The listing also describes a warranty covering repair costs after airline damage.
record.seo_title: Travelpro Platinum Magna 2 Expandable Luggage, 29in
record.meta_description: Travelpro Platinum Magna 2 black 29 inch expandable spinner suitcase with ballistic nylon, eight magnetic wheels, and a 3-position handle. Weighs 11.3 pounds.
record.long_description:
This checked large spinner suitcase is built for longer trips, with a 29 inch case that can expand by an extra 2 inches. The shell is high density ballistic nylon with a coating, and it has top and side carry handles plus a bottom handle cup for different ways to lift it. The zipper heads are described as resistant to damage from regular use.

Rolling is handled by eight self-aligning magnetic wheels, which the listing says turn smoothly in any direction. The three position extension handle is meant to reduce wobble while you walk, and the case includes a cushioned grip and a suiter and tie-down system. The listing gives the weight as 11.3 pounds and the volume as 143.5 liters.

The Worry Free Warranty is a notable detail. According to the listing, it covers the cost of repair for damage caused by an airline or another common carrier. The case measures 29 by 20.5 by 12.75 inches before expansion, and the overall dimensions are listed as 32.5 by 21.5 by 12.75 inches, so measure against your airline's limits before you travel.

specs.sleep function: Wakes and sleeps with the cover

record.description: A slim plum colored fabric case for the Fire HD 10 tablet, made for the 7th and 9th generation models released in 2017 and 2019. It has a microfiber interior, a magnetic closure, and a built-in stand for landscape or portrait viewing. The cover can wake or sleep the tablet when opened or closed.
record.seo_title: Amazon Fire HD 10 Tablet Case, Plum
record.meta_description: Plum fabric case for Amazon Fire HD 10 tablets from the 7th and 9th generations. Magnetic full cover, microfiber lining, and a built-in stand.
record.long_description:
This case is designed by Amazon to fit the Fire HD 10 tablet. The listing states it is compatible with the 7th and 9th generation models from 2017 and 2019, so check your tablet's generation before ordering. The plum fabric wraps the device in a full cover, and a magnetic closure keeps it shut while you carry it.

Inside, the case has a microfiber lining meant to protect the screen and keep it clean. The cover is also designed to wake the tablet when you open it and put the tablet to sleep when you close it, so you do not need to press the power button each time. The listing says the case leaves the buttons, ports, and cameras accessible.

The built-in stand supports the tablet in landscape or portrait orientation. The case is described as slim, so it adds little bulk. Because the listing focuses on fit and protection, confirm the generation of your tablet before purchasing.

specs.capacity: Extra large, two or more weeks of mail

record.description: A black curbside mailbox and package drop with a secure parcel section and a separate letter slot. It is built from 16 gauge galvanized steel with a powder coated finish and stainless steel hinges. The listing says the unit is USPS approved and made in the USA.
record.seo_title: dVault Full Service Curbside Mailbox, Black
record.meta_description: dVault DVCS0015 black curbside mailbox with a secure package drop and letter slot. Built from 16 gauge galvanized steel and listed as USPS approved.
record.long_description:
This curbside unit combines a secure parcel drop and a separate letter slot in one black box. The package section is large enough for bigger items, and the seller says it can hold two or more weeks of mail and parcels. A separate mail drop includes an enclosed spot for outgoing letters, which keeps outgoing mail apart from deliveries.

The body is 16 gauge galvanized steel with a powder coated finish, and the hinges and fasteners are stainless steel. The listing describes a patented security drop door and an anti-pry locking system for the storage compartment. The product is described as USPS approved and made in the USA.

The listing suggests the box suits people who work from home, travel often, or receive a steady flow of letters and packages. It is a curbside product, so plan where it will mount before you buy. The model number is DVCS0015, which is useful when comparing versions or asking the seller about fit.

record.description: A collapsible play tunnel for small pets such as hamsters, guinea pigs, and rats. The set has three tunnels made of a cotton blend with a polyester lining, and plastic rings keep the openings round. It folds flat for storage and carrying.
record.seo_title: Rypet Collapsible Small Animal Play Tunnel
record.meta_description: Rypet collapsible play tunnel for hamsters, guinea pigs, rabbits, and ferrets. Three tunnels in a cotton blend fabric with plastic rings to keep openings round.
record.long_description:
This play tunnel gives small pets a place to run, explore, and hide. The set includes three tunnels, and the listing gives dimensions for a long tunnel and a short tunnel within the set. The outer fabric is a cotton blend with a camouflage pattern, and the inner layer is polyester. Plastic rings at the openings help the tunnels keep their shape.

The listing names several animals the tunnel is meant for, including rabbits, ferrets, guinea pigs, hamsters, and small puppies. The seller says the material is non-toxic and describes the tunnel as a way to encourage exercise. Because it folds down, it is easy to store between uses or pack for a trip.

The seller describes a replacement policy for breakage, covering items returned in their original packaging with accessories within one week. Damage caused by people is excluded. Before buying, measure the space where the tunnel will sit and consider whether your pet is likely to chew on fabric.

record.description: A 136 inch square projector screen with a white front surface and black backing for standard UHD and HD projectors. It is portable, with a tripod style frame and a carrying bag included. The listing describes a 180 degree viewing angle and a two year warranty.
record.seo_title: Elite Screens Tripod 136-Inch 1:1 Projector Screen
record.meta_description: Elite Screens 136 inch 1:1 tripod projector screen, white, with 1.1 gain and 180 degree viewing angle. Portable indoor and outdoor use with a carrying bag.
record.long_description:
This tripod-style projector screen is a portable option for showing video indoors or outdoors. The viewing area is 96 inches square, which gives a 136 inch diagonal at a 1:1 aspect ratio. The overall frame measures about 141 inches high, 102 inches wide, and 43 inches deep, and the case is white.

According to the listing, the front surface has a 1.1 gain and offers a 180 degree viewing angle, with a black backing behind it. The material is described as resistant to mold and easy to clean, and it carries green certifications for indoor use. The screen is listed as ready for 4K and 3D content, and it is not meant for ultra short throw or short throw projectors.

An auto locking mechanism is said to allow a range of height settings, and a standard keystone eliminator helps correct distortion when the projector sits high or low. The frame is described as heavy duty, and a carrying bag is included. The seller provides a two year warranty and offers support by email, web chat, or phone.

record.description: A decorative teapot with a road trip luggage design, measuring 5-1/2 inches. It is made of ceramic and dolomite and should be hand washed rather than placed in a dishwasher. It arrives in a gift box, so it is ready to present.
record.seo_title: Appletree Design Road Trip Luggage Teapot
record.meta_description: Appletree Design road trip luggage teapot, 5-1/2 inches, made of ceramic and dolomite. Hand wash only, and it comes in a gift box.
record.long_description:
This small teapot is styled to look like a piece of travel luggage, which makes it a playful addition to a kitchen or display shelf. The seller describes it as both functional and decorative, and the listing notes that it is colorful, which adds a lively touch to a home. At 5-1/2 inches, it is a compact size that suits a tabletop.

The teapot is made from ceramic and dolomite, and the seller says it was built with durability in mind. Care is simple but specific: hand washing only, with no dishwasher. Handle it gently and follow that care guidance to keep it in good condition.

Packaging is part of the appeal. The teapot comes in a gift box, so it can be given as a present without extra wrapping. The listing suggests it as a gift for yourself or someone who enjoys whimsical kitchenware. The listing does not mention the capacity, so check the seller's details if you plan to brew a specific amount of tea.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A full size four piece sheet set in lime green, with a fitted sheet, a flat sheet, and two pillowcases. The polyester microfiber is double brushed for a soft feel and is listed as wrinkle and fade resistant. Machine washing in cold water and low tumble drying are recommended.
record.seo_title: American Home Collection Full Sheet Set, Lime Green
record.meta_description: American Home Collection full size 4 piece sheet set in lime green. Double brushed polyester microfiber with a fitted sheet, flat sheet, and two pillowcases.
record.long_description:
This four piece bedding set covers a full size bed with a fitted sheet, a flat sheet, and two pillowcases in a bright lime green. The fabric is 100 percent polyester microfiber, which the seller says is made from high strength yarns. It is double brushed for a softer hand, and the listing describes it as resistant to fading, staining, shrinking, and wrinkles.

The listed dimensions for the full set are a fitted sheet measuring 54 by 75 inches with a 16 inch deep pocket, a flat sheet at 81 by 96 inches, and pillowcases at 20 by 30 inches. The pillowcases have envelope closures.

Care is straightforward when you follow the instructions. The listing recommends machine washing in cold water with like colors, avoiding bleach and fabric softener, followed by tumble drying on low. It also advises against washing the set with heavy items such as jeans, since zippers and studs can damage the fabric. The seller says the factory follows OEKO-TEX Standard 100.

record.description: A bulk classpack of 120 woodless colored pencils in twelve assorted colors, with ten sticks of each shade. The pentagon shaped barrels let you use different edges for wide or narrow marks. Changing hand pressure lets you blend or shade.
record.seo_title: Crayola Woodless Colored Pencils, 120 Count
record.meta_description: Crayola woodless colored pencils, a 120 count classpack with 12 assorted colors and 10 of each. Pentagon shaped for broad strokes or fine lines.
record.long_description:
This classpack gives a classroom or home studio a large set of colored pencils in one order. The assortment covers twelve colors, including white, grey, black, tan, violet, blue, sky blue, green, red, orange, yellow, and brown, with ten sticks of each. Because the pencils are woodless, there is no wood to cut away when sharpening.

The pencils are pentagon shaped and solid colored, which the listing says leaves no sharpening waste. Each stick offers more than one edge, so you can switch between a broad side for wide strokes and a point for fine lines. Adjusting hand pressure lets you blend and shade colors.

These pencils suit school projects, drawing lessons, and creative work. The listing does not mention whether the set includes sharpeners or a storage case, so plan for those separately if you need them. Overall, the pack is a straightforward option for anyone who needs a large quantity of colored pencils.

specs.wiring: Needs existing outdoor wiring and junction box
specs.features: Human detection, two-way audio, smart siren

record.description: A weatherproof floodlight camera with 1080p live streaming and recording, rated at 2,500 lumens for bright night footage. It adds human detection, motion alerts, two way audio, and a built-in siren. It needs existing outdoor wiring and a weatherproof junction box.
record.seo_title: eufy Security 1080p Floodlight Camera, 2500 Lumens
record.meta_description: eufy Security 1080p floodlight camera with 2,500 lumens, two way audio, human detection, and a smart siren. Needs existing outdoor wiring and a junction box.
record.long_description:
This floodlight camera combines a bright outdoor light with a security camera in one fixture. The camera streams and records video in 1080p, and the listing says the 2,500 lumen light allows full color footage at night. Motion can trigger the floodlights, and the system can detect people, send alerts, and let you talk with someone nearby using two way audio.

The listing also points to a built-in siren, which can sound a loud alarm to discourage unwanted visitors. The product is described as weatherproof, and the seller says it carries no monthly fees because it is a one time purchase. The listing notes that it is not compatible with HomeBase.

Installation depends on what is already at the site. The product requires existing outdoor wiring and a weatherproof junction box, so an electrician may be needed if those parts are not in place. Before ordering, check that your home already has the wiring and a suitable junction box so the unit can be mounted.

record.description: Black floor liners for the front and second row of a 2005 to 2015 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab. Each liner is shaped to match the vehicle's floor contours, and cleats help hold it in place. The listing says the liners are made in the USA.
record.seo_title: Husky Liners 98951 Black Floor Liners for Tacoma
record.meta_description: Husky Liners 98951 Weatherbeater floor liners for the front and second seat of 2005 to 2015 Toyota Tacoma Double Cab. Shaped fit and made in the USA.
record.long_description:
These floor liners are built for the front and second seat area of a Toyota Tacoma Double Cab from 2005 to 2015. The black Weatherbeater style is shaped to the contours of that vehicle, which the seller calls a FormFit design. A close fit helps the liner stay in place rather than sliding around on the carpet.

The liners use StayPut cleats to help hold them in position, which the listing describes as a way to keep them secure during use. The material is described as rugged and able to handle hard wear. The product is made in the USA, according to the listing.

Because this part is listed for a specific model, check the year, body style, and seat layout before you buy. The model number 98951 is printed in the listing and can help you confirm the match before ordering.

record.description: A two in one booster seat that converts from a highback booster to a backless booster. It is meant for children about 4 to 10 years old, from 40 to 100 pounds and up to 57 inches tall. The seat includes energy absorbing foam and a multi layer headrest.
record.seo_title: Graco TurboBooster Highback Booster Seat, Green
record.meta_description: Graco TurboBooster highback booster seat in green for children 40 to 100 pounds and up to 57 inches tall. Converts to a backless booster.
record.long_description:
The TurboBooster is a two in one booster seat for growing children. It can be used as a highback booster or converted to a backless booster, and the listing says that flexibility lets it last for years. The seat is meant for children between roughly 4 and 10 years old, from 40 to 100 pounds, and up to 57 inches tall.

The seller notes that the minimum weight was raised from 30 to 40 pounds to keep up with industry standards. The highback provides full coverage back support as the child grows, according to the listing. The seat has a multi layer headrest meant to add comfort, and it includes EPS, an energy absorbing foam, to help manage impact.

The seat is listed in green under the title Go Green. Before using any booster seat, read the labels and the manual that comes with it, and check that your child meets the stated weight and height limits. Installation and fit should follow the instructions provided with the seat.

record.description: A women's strapless bikini set in blue, sized S to match US size 4. The padded bra has an adjustable lace-up back, and the high cut bottom sits at a natural waist. It is made of stretchy polyester and spandex with a ribbed texture.
record.seo_title: ZAFUL Women's Strapless Ribbed Bikini Set, Blue
record.meta_description: ZAFUL women's strapless ribbed bikini set in blue, size S, with a padded bra, lace-up back, and high cut bottom. Polyester and spandex blend.
record.long_description:
This two piece swimsuit set pairs a strapless bandeau bra with a high cut bottom. The fabric is a stretchy ribbed blend of polyester and spandex, and the cutout center and frilled details add shape. The bra is padded and wire free, and it closes at the back with an adjustable lace-up design.

The bottom sits at a natural waist, and the tie at the back can be adjusted. The set includes one bra and one bottom. The listing gives size S as fitting US size 4, with a bust of 32 to 34 inches, a waist of 24 to 26 inches, and hips of 34 to 36 inches. Sizes M and L are also listed, each with its own measurements.

The seller notes that measurements are taken by hand and can differ by about one to two centimeters. Colors may also look different on screen, depending on the monitor. The set is suited to beach trips, pool days, and vacations, according to the listing.

record.description: A pair of pop up kids' soccer goals measuring 4 by 3 feet, with Dacron netting and fiberglass poles. The frames fold down for carrying to a park, school, or backyard. The listing describes them as made for practicing skills at home.
record.seo_title: Dimples Excel Kids Soccer Goals 4x3 ft, Set of 2
record.meta_description: Dimples Excel pop up kids soccer goals, two pack sized 4 by 3 feet, with Dacron netting and fiberglass poles. Folds for easy carrying and backyard practice.
record.long_description:
This pair of pop up soccer goals is sized for young players who want to practice at home. Each goal measures 4 by 3 feet, and the listing says a child can set one up and fold it without much help. The netting is made from Dacron, which the seller says is stronger than typical goal nets, and the poles are fiberglass rather than heavier steel.

The goals are designed to be portable. Folded, they are light enough for a child to carry on the shoulder to a local park, playground, or school. The listing says the folded size fits the trunk of a small car, which may help if you plan to take them to practice sessions away from home.

The seller describes the product as made for backyard skills practice and suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The listing includes a video of a child setting up the goals, and it gives the folded size and weight in its product pictures. Check those pictures for exact dimensions before buying.

record.description: Two tone hollow core scooter wheels in a 120 millimeter size, released as the Jon Reyes signature model. The hollow core is intended to reduce weight. The listing says they fit Envy scooters from 2016 and later.
record.seo_title: Envy Scooters 120mm Hollowcore Wheels, Jon Reyes
record.meta_description: Envy Scooters 120mm two tone hollow core wheels, the Jon Reyes signature model, with 26 mm urethane for control. Listed for Envy scooters from 2016 on.
record.long_description:
These are scooter wheels from Envy Scooters, sold as the Jon Reyes signature model. They measure 120 millimeters across and use a two tone design that the seller says is a nod to Reyes's hometown of New York City. The core is hollow, a choice the listing says reduces weight and improves the ride.

Each wheel uses 26 millimeter urethane, which is listed as about 2 millimeters thicker than many standard wheels. The seller says the extra width gives the rider more control on different surfaces. The design is described as suited to a particular riding style, and the listing presents it as a top quality option from the brand.

The listing says the wheels are compatible with Envy model scooters from 2016 onward. Check your scooter's model year before ordering, and confirm that the wheel size matches your existing setup.

specs.fits: Umbrellas up to 11 ft in diameter

record.description: A see-through mesh screen that slips over a patio umbrella up to 11 feet across to keep bugs away from your meal. The top has an adjustable cinch closure, and two zippers give easy access. The cover is lightweight and folds for storage.
record.seo_title: IdeaWorks 11ft Umbrella Table Screen, Bug-Free
record.meta_description: IdeaWorks mesh umbrella table screen for patio umbrellas up to 11 feet across. Adjustable cinch top, double zipper entry, and a lightweight, foldable design.
record.long_description:
This mesh cover is made to keep insects off an outdoor table while you eat. It installs over the umbrella so the mesh hangs down around the meal, and the listing says the see-through screen helps keep out pests such as flies and mosquitoes. The cover is designed for umbrellas up to 11 feet in diameter.

Setup is simple. The screen slips over the umbrella, and an adjustable top cinch closure gives it a flexible fit. A large double zippered entrance lets you and your guests get in and out easily. The seller also describes the cover as lightweight.

When you are done, the cover can be removed, folded, and stored away. Measure your umbrella's diameter before ordering, since the listing states the maximum size and the cover should match it.

record.description: A beige bunion splint with gel toe separators and breathable elastic fabric, designed for day and night wear. An elastic loop around the heel helps keep it from slipping off. The listing says it fits most US sizes from 6 to 11.
record.seo_title: SINROBO Bunion Corrector Splint, Day and Night
record.meta_description: SINROBO bunion corrector splint in beige for day and night wear, with gel toe separators, breathable elastic fabric, and a heel loop for US sizes 6 to 11.
record.long_description:
This bunion splint is a beige sleeve that wraps around the foot and toes, with gel separators between the toes and a heel loop that helps hold it on. The listing describes it as a support for bunion discomfort and for other toe concerns such as overlapping toes. It is made from breathable elastic fabric that the seller says follows the shape of the foot.

The gel separator is described as medical grade and hypoallergenic, and the listing notes that it can be cleaned and reused. The product is intended for wear during the day and at night, and the seller says it can also be used after surgery. It is not a substitute for advice from a doctor or podiatrist, so anyone with a foot condition should speak with a professional first.

Sizing covers most US feet from size 6 to 11, according to the listing. The elastic loop around the heel is meant to keep the splint in place while sleeping. The seller suggests wearing socks if you want a snugger fit. Because the product sits inside shoes, it is designed to be discreet with everyday footwear.

specs.radio: FM radio with sleep timer, 10 to 120 minutes

record.description: A smart wake up light that works with Alexa or Google Home and simulates sunrise and sunset. It offers four alarms, a snooze button, and an FM radio with a sleep timer. The light needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network to connect.
record.seo_title: LBell Smart Wake Up Light with Alexa and Google
record.meta_description: LBell smart wake up light with sunrise simulation, four alarms, FM radio, and Alexa or Google Home voice control on a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
record.long_description:
This wake up light is designed to ease you into the morning with a gradual sunrise effect rather than a sudden alarm. The light brightens over time, and the listing says it can be paired with nature sounds or the FM radio. The seller also offers a sunset fade for winding down, along with several color and brightness settings for reading or a night light.

The device works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home for voice commands. The listing says no separate hub is needed, but the light does need a Wi-Fi connection and supports only the 2.4 GHz band. Four alarms can be set for different times on the same day, which the seller says can suit different schedules, such as one alarm for each person in a household.

Snooze is handled by a button that mutes the sound for a set interval, and the listing says it can be repeated up to 12 times. The FM radio can store preset stations and includes a sleep timer for periods between 10 and 120 minutes. Check the Wi-Fi band on your router before setting up the light.

specs.microphone: Inline mic and remote, no volume control
specs.compatibility: Listed USB-C phones, tablets, and laptops

record.description: USB-C in-ear earphones with hi-res audio up to 24 bit and 96 kHz and a built-in DAC chipset. The inline remote has a microphone for calls but no volume control. The set comes with small, medium, and large earpads and a flat, tangle-free cable.
record.seo_title: TriLink USB C Earbud Headphones, Hi-Res In-Ear
record.meta_description: TriLink USB-C earbud headphones with hi-res audio up to 24 bit/96 kHz, an inline mic and remote, and S/M/L earpads. Check the compatibility list before buying.
record.long_description:
These USB-C earphones are built to connect directly to phones, tablets, and laptops with a USB Type-C port. The seller says the built-in DAC chipset supports both digital and analog input signals, which helps the earphones work with many USB-C audio outputs. The 10 millimeter drivers are intended to deliver a strong bass response, and the audio is described as supporting up to 24 bit and 96 kHz.

The inline remote and microphone let you answer calls, pause music, or skip tracks without taking out your phone. The listing notes that the remote has no volume control, so you will need to adjust volume on the device itself. The cable is flat and tangle resistant, and the set includes small, medium, and large earpads so you can choose a fit.

Compatibility is the key point to check. The listing includes a long list of phones, tablets, and laptops, including several iPad, MacBook, Google Pixel, and Huawei models. The seller also states a satisfaction guarantee and offers customer support, but you should compare your device against the list before buying.

record.description: A two pack of brush on nail glue that applies evenly and bonds quickly. The built-in brush is designed to help avoid air bubbles and allow precise placement. It is meant for attaching artificial nails and works on natural nails as well.
record.seo_title: Kiss Lightning Speed Brush-On Nail Glue, 2 Pack
record.meta_description: Kiss brush-on nail glue in a 2 pack. Built-in brush for even application, fast drying, and bonds artificial and natural nails for a secure hold.
record.long_description:
This two pack of nail glue comes with a built-in brush for applying a thin, even layer to the nail. The seller says the glue bonds quickly and dries fast, which can shorten the wait between steps. It is meant for attaching artificial nails and works on natural nails too, according to the listing.

Because the brush is part of the applicator, you can place the glue with more control. The listing says the design helps prevent air pockets under the nail. The product is described as applying like nail polish, so the process may feel familiar to anyone who already paints their nails.

Each case contains two bottles, and the listing describes the glue as high quality with strong holding power. Before use, read the instructions on the package and test a small amount on one nail if you are new to nail glue.

specs.outsole: AHAR rubber in high wear areas

record.description: Women's running shoes in pink and white, sized 8.5, with a 19 millimeter heel height and an 11 millimeter forefoot height. The mesh upper, lightweight midsole, and rubber outsole are listed as supportive and durable for running. The listing positions them for training and racing.
record.seo_title: ASICS Women's Dynaflyte 3 Running Shoes, Pink
record.meta_description: ASICS women's Dynaflyte 3 running shoes in pink and white, size US 8.5, with FlyteFoam Lyte midsole, Adapt Mesh 2.0 upper, and rearfoot GEL cushioning.
record.long_description:
The Dynaflyte 3 is ASICS's women's running shoe for runners who want cushioning and a responsive ride. The seller describes a redesigned upper with Adapt Mesh 2.0, which is meant to offer support and flexibility, and a midsole made from FlyteFoam Lyte, which the brand says is its lightest midsole formulation. The shoe is listed in size 8.5 with a 19 millimeter heel height and an 11 millimeter forefoot height.

Several technologies are highlighted in the listing. The Impact Guidance System is described as linking components to help the foot move naturally from heel strike to toe off, and the rearfoot GEL system is meant to absorb shock during impact. The AHAR outsole places high abrasion rubber in critical areas to add durability where the shoe wears most.

The seller positions the shoe for training and racing, and says the fit is designed to be secure without being restrictive. Runners who train on pavement or trails may want to compare the outsole details with their routes. If you usually wear a different width, check the size chart on the brand site before ordering.

specs.use: Full color, root touch up, enhancing natural color

record.description: A permanent hair color creme in the Mascarpone Creme PL2 shade, sold as a single pack. It is enriched with avocado, olive, and shea oils and is described as non-drip. It can also be used for root touch ups or to enhance your natural color.
record.seo_title: Garnier Nutrisse Ultra Color Creme, PL2 Shade
record.meta_description: Garnier Nutrisse Ultra Color creme in Mascarpone Creme PL2, a permanent hair color with avocado, olive, and shea oils. Single pack for root touch ups.
record.long_description:
This permanent hair color is a creme formula in the Mascarpone Creme PL2 shade, sold as a single pack. The seller says it is designed to deliver bold color, including on dark hair, with a color boost technology. The formula is enriched with a blend of fruit oils, including avocado, olive, and shea, and the brand says it nourishes hair as it colors.

The creme is described as rich and non-drip, which the listing says makes it easier to apply. The product can be used for full color, for root touch ups, or to enhance your natural hair color. The brand also sells shampoos, styling products, and skin care items, and the listing highlights its history in hair care going back to 1904.

Read the instructions and warnings inside the kit before use. Checking the instructions first and following them as written is the safest way to use any permanent hair dye, and the listing does not replace the printed directions.

record.description: Thin silicone stackable rings with a triangle diamond design, sold in packs of 1, 4, 8, 12, or 16. Each ring is 2.5 millimeters wide and 2 millimeters thick. The listing describes the silicone as hypoallergenic and flexible for active or hands on routines.
record.seo_title: ThunderFit Silicone Triangle Diamond Stackable Rings
record.meta_description: ThunderFit silicone triangle diamond stackable rings, 2.5 mm wide, in packs of 1 to 16. Hypoallergenic, flexible, and listed with a money back guarantee.
record.long_description:
These stackable rings are made from silicone and shaped in a triangle diamond design. The listing presents them as an alternative to a metal wedding band during workouts, climbing, or hands-on work. The seller describes the silicone as flexible and hypoallergenic, and says the ring is designed to break away under heavy pressure.

Each ring measures 2.5 millimeters wide and about 2 millimeters thick, which keeps the profile slim. The listing offers packs of 1, 4, 8, 12, or 16 rings, so you can choose a quantity to suit a stack or a single replacement band. The flexible design is described as suited to larger knuckles or temporary swelling in the fingers.

The seller positions the rings as gifts for anniversaries, birthdays, and holidays. It also offers a 100 percent money back guarantee, which the listing says covers any product that does not meet expectations. Before buying, check the pack size and the ring size you need.

specs.includes: Neoprene strap, microfiber lens cloth, cotton pouch

specs.warranty: Replacement in first year for loss or breakage

record.description: An accessory pack for children's sunglasses with a neoprene strap, a microfiber lens cloth, and a cotton pouch. The listing says Babiators frames are flexible rubber and the lenses are shatter resistant with UVA and UVB protection. It is presented as a gift set for young explorers.
record.seo_title: Babiators Kids Sunglass Accessories Pack
record.meta_description: Babiators kids sunglass accessories pack with a neoprene strap, microfiber lens cloth, and cotton pouch. The listing describes UVA and UVB protective lenses.
record.long_description:
This accessory pack is designed to go with children's sunglasses from Babiators. It includes a neoprene strap to help keep glasses in place, a soft microfiber cloth for cleaning the lenses, and a cotton pouch for storage. The seller presents the set as a gift for young travelers who want to be ready before heading outside.

The brand's frames are described in the listing as flexible rubber, and the lenses as impact and shatter resistant, so the glasses are meant to hold up when children bend or step on them. The lenses are also described as UVA and UVB protective. The listing shows a range of frame styles, including hearts, keyholes, navigators, and aviators.

The seller offers a replacement during the first year if glasses are lost or broken, although shipping is not included. The listing describes this as an accessories pack, so sunglasses may need to be bought separately. The pack is still useful for cleaning and carrying a pair you already own.

record.description: Relaxed fit men's jeans in big and tall sizing, made from cotton denim with five pockets. They sit at the natural waist with room through the seat and thigh. The jeans close with a zipper fly and button, and have embroidered back pockets.
record.seo_title: Wrangler Authentics Men's Big & Tall Relaxed Jeans
record.meta_description: Wrangler Authentics men's big and tall relaxed fit cotton jeans in vintage stonewash, 50 waist by 30 inseam. Five pockets, zipper fly, and a natural waist.
record.long_description:
These men's jeans are cut in a relaxed fit for larger builds, with extra room through the seat and thigh. The waist sits at the natural waist, and the five pocket design follows a classic layout with a watch pocket, front scoop pockets, and back patch pockets. The color is listed as vintage stonewash.

The fabric is cotton denim, which the seller says is durable enough for long days. The listing calls out the breathable quality of the cotton, which makes the jeans comfortable for yard work or a physical job. The hardware includes a zipper fly, a button closure, and embroidered back pockets.

The sizing for this pair is a 50 inch waist and a 30 inch inseam, in the big and tall range. Because the waist and length are both given in the title, check your measurements against those numbers before ordering. The listing is focused on everyday durability and comfort, so the jeans suit casual and working wear.

specs.use: Antenna builds, ham radio, and balun projects

record.description: A 50 foot thin RG-316 coaxial cable in brown, rated at 50 ohms with a maximum frequency of 6 GHz. The conductor and braid are silver plated copper, and the jacket is Teflon. The listing suggests it for antenna work, ham radio, and balun projects.
record.seo_title: XRDS-RF RG-316 Coax Cable, 50 ft, Thin Brown
record.meta_description: XRDS-RF RG-316 coax cable, 50 feet long in brown, 50 ohm, rated to 6 GHz, with a silver plated copper conductor and a thin Teflon jacket.
record.long_description:
This RG-316 coaxial cable is a thin, flexible option for antenna and radio projects. The listing describes it as a miniature coax with a diameter of about 0.1 inch, which makes it easier to route through tight spaces. The cable is 50 feet long and carries a 50 ohm impedance, and the seller gives its maximum frequency as 6 GHz.

The inner conductor and braid are silver plated copper, which the seller says keeps signal loss low. The outer jacket is Teflon, and the listing says it can handle harsh outdoor conditions. The core is stranded, so it stays flexible when bent. The listing notes that SMA connectors can be fitted by crimping.

The listing suggests the cable for VHF and UHF work, interconnections, balun antennas, ham radio, LTE, ADS-B, and Wi-Fi projects. Some figures for attenuation and standing wave ratio vary between sections of the listing, so review those numbers carefully before building anything that depends on them.

record.description: An eight panel plastic play yard for babies, creating a 34.4 square foot space that is 26 inches tall. It folds up with a carrying strap and includes non-slip pads. The listing says it is JPMA certified and made in the USA for babies aged 6 to 24 months.
record.seo_title: Toddleroo by North States Superyard Play Yard
record.meta_description: Toddleroo by North States Superyard Colorplay 8 panel baby play yard, 34.4 square feet, folds with a carrying strap, JPMA certified for ages 6 to 24 months.
record.long_description:
This play yard offers an enclosed area for a baby to play indoors or outdoors. It has eight colorful plastic panels that set up to about 34.4 square feet of play space, and the yard stands 26 inches tall. The seller says it is freestanding and sets up and folds quickly, so it can move between rooms or travel with you.

The listing notes a carrying strap and non-slip pads, and describes the durable plastic as difficult for pets or children to climb. The seller also says the yard is JPMA certified and safe for babies from 6 to 24 months. It is made in the USA, according to the listing.

For larger spaces, the listing describes an extra wide barrier option. Using up to six panels with a wall mount kit sold separately, the yard can block openings from about 38 inches to more than 16 feet wide. A folding play mat sold separately is also said to work with the yard. Check the fit and age guidance before use, and follow the instructions included with the product.

record.description: A men's work boot in dark brown, size 10 medium, with a six inch shaft and a soft toe. The full grain leather upper is waterproof, and the rubber outsole is meant to add traction. A cushioned footbed is included.
record.seo_title: WOLVERINE Men's Floorhand 6 Inch Waterproof Boot
record.meta_description: WOLVERINE Men's Floorhand 6 inch waterproof soft toe work boot in dark brown, size US 10 M. Full grain leather upper, rubber outsole, and a cushioned footbed.
record.long_description:
This work boot is built for men who spend long days on their feet. The upper is full grain waterproof leather that the listing says is meant to stand up to wear, and the boot stands six inches tall. It has a soft toe, and the listing does not say whether it meets any protective standard.

The rubber outsole is meant to add traction, and the cushioned footbed is described as comfortable for all day wear. The listing presents the boot as a durable choice for work and yard tasks, and the dark brown color gives it a traditional look.

This pair is listed in US men's size 10 medium. Measure your foot and compare it with the seller's size guide before ordering, since work boots are often sized differently from casual shoes. If you can, try on a pair in person before you commit.

record.description: A silver wall mounted organizer for hair dryers, flat irons, curling wands, and brushes. It includes two cups for combs and brushes, a shelf, and compartments that keep tools separated. The listing says it mounts to a wall or cabinet door with included hardware.
record.seo_title: Lmeison Wall Mounted Hair Dryer Holder, Silver
record.meta_description: Lmeison wall mounted hair dryer holder in silver with divided compartments, two cups, and a shelf. Aluminum and steel frame mounts to a wall or cabinet door.
record.long_description:
This wall mounted organizer gives hair tools a home in a small bathroom. It has several compartments for a hair dryer, flat iron, curling wand, and brushes, and two cylindrical cups can hold combs or brushes. The seller says the spiral holder and bottom ledge keep items secure, and the open grid design is meant to let hot tools cool down safely.

The organizer is made from aluminum with a steel grid, finished in silver with an oxidized, polished look. The listing describes it as lightweight and rust resistant, and it is intended to suit modern bathroom decor. The package includes the holder, two cups, a shelf, and fittings in a bag.

Mounting is designed to work on a wall or on the front of a cabinet door, using the hardware included with the product. The listing says it fits most hair dryer sizes but recommends checking the size chart before buying. The seller suggests it for small spaces such as apartments, dorms, or RVs. Measure the dryer and flat iron you plan to store before ordering.

specs.features: Double billfold, ID window, RFID ID lock

record.description: A men's double billfold wallet in anthracite and black ballistic nylon. It measures about 3.8 by 4.8 by 0.8 inches and weighs 0.15 pounds. The interior has five card pockets, two slip pockets, and an ID window, plus an RFID ID lock.
record.seo_title: TUMI Alpha Global Double Billfold Wallet, Men's
record.meta_description: TUMI Alpha Global men's double billfold wallet in anthracite ballistic nylon with an RFID ID lock, five card pockets, two slip pockets, and an ID window.
record.long_description:
This men's wallet uses a double billfold design in a compact outer shape. The exterior is ballistic nylon in anthracite and black, and the wallet measures about 3.8 by 4.8 by 0.8 inches and weighs roughly 0.15 pounds. It is small enough for a pocket while still holding a useful number of cards and bills.

Inside, the wallet has five card pockets and two slip pockets for receipts or extra cards. An ID window lets you show an identification card without taking it out, and the listing says the RFID ID lock is meant to help protect cards from electronic reading. The interior layout combines pockets and billfold space for everyday use.

The seller lists the material as ballistic nylon, a fabric often chosen for its durability. The wallet suits a daily carry routine where a slim, compact wallet is preferred over a larger one. Before buying, compare the dimensions with the pockets of the clothing you usually wear.

specs.zones: Full back, upper back, lower back

record.description: A shiatsu massage cushion with heat that can be used on a chair, sofa, or recliner for the neck, shoulders, and back. It has rolling nodes with adjustable width and two vibration levels for the hips and thighs. The listing sets a 15 minute limit per session.
record.seo_title: Snailax Shiatsu Neck and Back Massager with Heat
record.meta_description: Snailax shiatsu neck and back massager with heat, rolling nodes, and vibration for hips and thighs. Detachable washable cover and a 15 minute session timer.
record.long_description:
This massage cushion is designed to sit on a chair or sofa and provide a kneading massage for the neck, shoulders, and back. Four shiatsu nodes are said to work the neck and shoulder area, and they can be raised or lowered to suit different heights. The listing says the neck feature suits people roughly 63 to 71 inches tall.

For the back, shiatsu nodes move up and down the spine and can be set to cover the full back, the upper back, or the lower back. A spot massage option focuses the nodes on one area, and infrared heating on the shiatsu balls is meant to add gentle warmth. A detachable flap can be installed when the massage feels too strong, and a rolling mode with adjustable width follows the spine.

The seat includes two vibration levels for the hips and thighs. The cover is detachable and washable, and the listing notes that a home adapter is included. The seller warns that each session should last no more than 15 minutes and that the massager should not be used more than three times in one day. Read the full warnings in the manual before use.

record.seo_title: Furinno Turn-N-Tube 2-Tier End Tables, 2-Pack
record.meta_description: Furinno Turn-N-Tube 2 tier shelves and end tables, a 2 pack in beech and white with particle board and PVC tubes. Tool free assembly in about five minutes.

These two tier shelves can be used as end tables or small storage units beside a sofa or bed. The set includes two pieces in a beech and white finish, and the design is described as simple and suited to most rooms. Each unit is built from engineered particle board and PVC tubes, which the listing presents as a combination that fits a modest budget.

Measured in inches, each piece is listed at roughly 23.6 wide, 11.6 deep, and 15.75 tall. The seller says the shelves are sturdy on a flat surface, so they are best placed on level floors. The listing emphasizes that assembly requires no tools and can be done in about five minutes, which suits people who prefer quick setup.

The product is sold in multiple color options, so shoppers can pick a finish that fits the room. Check the dimensions and confirm that the space will accommodate both pieces before buying.

specs.features: ID window and large billfold pocket

record.description: A slim billfold wallet for men in black genuine leather, measuring 3.25 by 4.25 inches. It has three credit card pockets, two slip pockets, an ID window, and a large billfold pocket. The listing says it fits in a front or back pocket.
record.seo_title: Timberland Men's Blix Slimfold Leather Wallet
record.meta_description: Timberland men's Blix slimfold genuine leather wallet in black, with three card pockets, two slip pockets, an ID window, and a slim profile for pockets.

This Blix slimfold wallet is made from genuine leather and designed to stay thin. The seller says it slips easily into jeans, dress pants, or shorts. The wallet measures about 3.25 by 4.25 inches and is available in black, brown, and burgundy, according to the listing. This copy is the black option.

The layout includes three credit card pockets, two slip pockets, one ID window, and a large billfold section for bills. The seller describes the wallet as built with tight stitching and precision manufacturing, which the brand says holds up under frequent use. Because the design is thin, it can be carried in either a front or back pocket.

Timberland is described as a brand known for construction and user friendly features. The listing presents this wallet as a practical everyday choice for someone who wants a compact design without giving up card storage. Compare the size with your pockets before buying, and consider how many cards you carry to see whether three card slots meet your needs.

record.description: A long smocked maxi sundress in 100 percent rayon, with rasta inspired colors of gold, green, red, and black. The straps are removable and adjustable, and the smocked chest gives a fitted feel. The listing says sizes run from S to 3X.

The dress is made from 100 percent rayon, which the listing describes as soft, lightweight, and cool to wear in warm weather.

The smocked chest is intended to give a comfortable fit and a textured look, while the semi loose body is meant to allow movement. The straps are removable and adjustable, so the dress can be worn with straps for a more structured look or without them for a looser style. The seller says the dress suits the beach, vacations, or everyday outings.

Sizes run from S to 3X, and the listing says the range is meant to suit petite, plus size, and in between figures. Care is described as machine washing friendly, with the color and softness said to hold up through repeated washes. Check the size guidance before ordering, since fit can vary with body measurements and the length you prefer.

If you want to display your team pride in a simple way, this pair offers an easy option that matches a black vehicle finish and adds a bit of style to the rear of any car.

The machine can work with hard candy or regular sugar and produces wispy cotton candy at roughly two to three servings per minute. A large 20 inch stainless steel bowl catches the spun sugar, and a sugar scoop is included for filling. The unit is designed to come apart so you can clean it more easily after use. VIVO lists a one year manufacturer warranty and offers tech support for questions. The listing notes that the product ships in two separate boxes, which may not arrive at the same time, so plan for that when ordering.

record.description: Black 15 foot power cord from Tripp Lite with a standard 5-15P plug on one end and an IEC-320-C13 connector on the other. It is rated 10A and uses 18 AWG wire. The listing describes it as a replacement cable for a computer, printer, or monitor with matching plugs.
record.seo_title: Tripp Lite 15 ft Computer Power Cord, Black
record.meta_description: Tripp Lite 15 foot black power cord with a 5-15P plug and an IEC-320-C13 connector. Rated 10A, 18 AWG, and UL listed for computers, printers, and monitors.

The model number P006-015 appears in the title if you need to match this item against an existing cable or a parts list.

record.seo_title: TRD Leather Shift Knob, Genuine Toyota Product
