record.long_description: This die cut decal shows a cowboy hat in white and measures about 6.5 by 3.5 inches. It is made from exterior grade material that the listing describes as rated for six years of outdoor use. The decal is intended for smooth, clean surfaces such as windows, cars, lockers, and laptops. Clear transfer tape is included to help you place it, and the listing provides application instructions for a neat finish. Only the white design is meant to be applied. The decal is a single piece, so one order gives you one hat design. Clean the surface before applying the decal, and let it set after placement. Check your surface type and size before buying to make sure the decal suits your project.

record.description: A mouse pad with a gel-filled wrist rest, decorated with a pink planet and moon design. The surface is smooth Lycra cloth meant for steady mouse movement, and the base is non-slip PU. The listing states that the pad is non-toxic and odorless. It measures about 8.7 by 7.2 inches.
record.seo_title: ITNRSIIET Gel Wrist Rest Mouse Pad, Pink Moon
record.meta_description: ITNRSIIET ergonomic gel wrist rest mouse pad with a pink moon design, smooth Lycra surface, non-slip PU base and 8.7 by 7.2 inch size.
record.long_description: This mouse pad combines a mouse surface with a gel-filled wrist rest. The pad is decorated with a pink planet and moon design and measures 8.7 by 7.2 by 0.7 inches, weighing 5.6 ounces. The surface is covered in a smooth Lycra cloth that the listing says allows steady, accurate mouse movement. The gel cushion is meant to help keep the hand in a neutral position during long computer sessions. The base is a non-slip PU material that is intended to keep the pad in place on the desk. The listing says the pad carries a RoHS certificate and is non-toxic and odorless. The edges are reinforced, and the surface is described as waterproof and easy to wipe clean. Check the measurements against your desk space before ordering.

record.description: A low profile recessed box for mounting a flat screen TV on a wall with shallow drywall. It fits drywall that is either 1/2 inch or 5/8 inch thick and has a depth of 1.25 inch. The kit includes one box and one UL listed decorator style receptacle. The white trim can be painted for a finished look.
record.seo_title: Arlington TVL508-1 Low Profile TV Box, 8 x 5 Inch
record.meta_description: Arlington low profile recessed TV box for flat screen mounting in shallow 1/2 or 5/8 inch drywall. Includes one box and one UL listed receptacle.
record.long_description: The Arlington TVL508-1 is a recessed box built for flat screen TVs, including LCD, LED and plasma models. Its 8 by 5 inch opening suits walls with shallow depth, working with drywall that is either 1/2 inch or 5/8 inch thick. At 1.25 inch deep, the box is sized for that thin wall space. The kit can be used in retrofit projects on finished walls as well as in new construction. Each pack includes one TV box and one UL listed decorator style receptacle, so the power outlet comes in the same kit. The frame is low profile, which lets the mounted TV sit close to the wall. The white trim can be painted after installation, so you can match it to the wall color and finish the job neatly. It is sold as a single unit, so buy a second kit if you need more than one mount. Check your local wiring rules before cutting into a wall, since the listing does not cover code requirements for your home.

record.description: A permanent professional hair color cream from Il Salone Milano in shade 10.1, Very Light Iced Blonde. It is designed to cover gray hair fully and includes moisturizing oils. The kit is a three step routine covering a pre-treatment, the color and a post-treatment.
record.seo_title: Il Salone Milano 10.1 Very Light Iced Blonde Hair Color
record.meta_description: Il Salone Milano permanent hair color in shade 10.1 Very Light Iced Blonde. Offers full gray coverage with moisturizing oils and a three step system.
record.long_description: This permanent hair color cream comes from the Il Salone Milano line, which is produced in Italy and sold through the Alfaparf Group. The shade is 10.1, named Very Light Iced Blonde, and the maker says the formula covers 100 percent of white hair. The cream contains moisturizing oils, including linseed and meadowfoam seed oil, which the listing credits with softness and shine. The brand says its colors are free from parabens, paraffins and ethyl alcohol. The kit is laid out as a three step system: a pre-treatment, the color cream itself, and a post-treatment to finish the routine. As a permanent formula it is designed for long lasting color, and it is positioned as a professional salon product rather than a basic drugstore dye. Follow the directions included with the kit closely, and read all warnings on the package before you mix and apply it.

specs.scent notes: Orange, lemon, jasmine and woody amber

record.description: A high efficiency liquid laundry detergent from Gain in the Original scent, enough for 146 loads. The fragrance is built on fruity and green notes, with orange, lemon and blossoms on top and a hint of woody amber underneath.
record.seo_title: Gain Original High Efficiency Liquid Laundry Detergent
record.meta_description: Gain Original liquid laundry detergent, high efficiency, 146 loads. Its fresh fruity, green scent blends orange, lemon, jasmine and a hint of amber.
record.long_description: Gain Original liquid laundry detergent is a high efficiency formula sized for 146 loads, which makes it a practical choice for households that run the washer often. The scent is a fresh, modern take on fruity and green fragrances, with bright citrus and blossom notes at the top, a white floral jasmine note in the middle and a faint woody amber finish beneath. The detergent is intended for high efficiency washing machines, so use the amount printed on the label for your load size rather than guessing. Because the scent is strong, people who are sensitive to fragrance may want to test a small load first. The listing covers scent and load count, so check the bottle for ingredient details and care directions before using it on delicate fabrics.

specs.free of: Soy, gluten, milk, egg, corn, wheat, peanuts

record.description: A krill oil softgel supplement from NatureMyst, sold as a 60 count bottle of liquid softgels. The oil is described as wild caught and cold processed, with omega-3 fatty acids bound in phospholipid form. The product is made in the USA in a GMP certified facility.
record.seo_title: NatureMyst Krill Oil 60 Softgels, Non-GMO Supplement
record.meta_description: NatureMyst krill oil supplement with 60 liquid softgels, made in the USA. Lists 1000 mg krill oil per serving with omega-3s in phospholipid form.
record.long_description: NatureMyst Krill Oil is a dietary supplement packaged as 60 liquid softgels. Each serving is listed at 1000 mg of krill oil. The company describes the krill as wild caught from deep ocean water, and says the oil is cold processed with supercritical CO2 extraction and then molecularly distilled to reduce contaminants. The omega-3 fatty acids are said to be carried in phospholipid form, which the listing presents as easier for the body to use. The softgels are coated to limit oxidation of the oil. The label states the product is non-GMO and gluten free and is made without common allergens such as soy, milk, egg, corn, wheat and peanuts. Production is described as taking place in the USA at a GMP-certified facility, and the listing mentions third party testing for purity and potency. This is a supplement, so check with a healthcare provider before starting it, especially if you take other medications.

specs.included: Cleaning cloth, cleaning brush, small jewelry bag

record.description: A two layer jewelry box from VEEKALA with a faux leather covering, an MDF frame and a velvet lining. It has a lock, a removable top tray, and compartments for necklaces, rings, bracelets and watches. The black box measures 23 by 18.8 by 9 cm.
record.seo_title: VEEKALA Two Layer Leather Jewelry Box with Lock
record.meta_description: VEEKALA two layer black jewelry box with faux leather cover, velvet lining and a lock. Removable tray and compartments hold necklaces, rings and bracelets.
record.long_description: The VEEKALA jewelry case has two levels for keeping a varied collection organized. The top tray is removable and offers a ring slot and compartments for brooches, earrings and cuffs, while the lid holds five necklace hooks and a small storage bag. The bottom section is divided into six compartments for bracelets, watches and small cosmetics such as lipstick. The outside is covered in faux leather over a medium density fiberboard frame, and the interior is lined with soft velvet meant to prevent scratches. A lock adds a basic measure of security. The listing describes the design as compact enough for a dresser or vanity, and it is sized at about 23 by 18.8 by 9 cm. The set includes a cleaning cloth, a small brush and a small jewelry bag. The listing advises keeping the box dry and cleaning the leather with a soft cloth and leather wax rather than water or detergent.

record.description: A climbing carabiner from Black Diamond called the RockLock Magnetron. Magnets in the gate and a steel insert in the nose create a self-locking closure that works with either hand. The classic RockLock shape is aimed at belaying, anchor building and rappelling.
record.seo_title: Black Diamond RockLock Magnetron Carabiner
record.meta_description: Black Diamond RockLock Magnetron carabiner with magnetic gate arms and a keylock nose that resists snagging. Suited to belaying, anchors and rappelling.
record.long_description: The Black Diamond RockLock Magnetron is an auto-locking carabiner that replaces a spring gate with magnets. Two magnetic arms sit in the gate, and a steel insert in the nose meets them to close the carabiner. The maker describes this as a secure and redundant closure that can be operated with one hand or the other. The keylock nose is meant to keep slings and ropes from catching on the tip. The square hinge end holds a belay loop in place, and the spine is slightly curved so the gate opens wider. The shape follows the classic RockLock design, which the listing recommends for belaying, building anchors and rappelling. The listing does not state a weight, strength rating or material beyond the magnetic arms and steel insert, so check the product markings and the manufacturer documentation before relying on it in a climbing system.

specs.closure: Ankle to chin zipper with snap-over tab

record.description: A three pack of footless cotton pajamas for baby girls in a 24 month size. The fit is snug, as the listing notes for sleepwear safety. Prints include dinosaur, space and rainbow designs.
record.seo_title: Simple Joys by Carter's Baby Girls Cotton Pajamas
record.meta_description: Simple Joys by Carter's three pack of snug fit footless cotton pajamas for baby girls, 24 months, in dinosaur, space and rainbow prints.
record.long_description: This three pack of baby girls sleepwear from Simple Joys by Carter's comes in a 24 month size. The pajamas are footless and made of cotton, with ribbed cuffs at the sleeves and legs for a neat finish. A zipper runs from the ankle to the chin and closes with a snap-over tab, which makes dressing a child simpler. The listing explains that sleepwear should be either flame resistant or snug fitting for safety, and states that this set is snug fitting. The three sets feature dinosaur, space and rainbow designs, so each child can have a different print. The brand is described as offering everyday low prices, and the packaging is tag free, which the listing says makes the pajamas comfortable against the skin. Check the care label before washing so the cotton keeps its shape.

record.description: A large black mechanic's glove from CLC Custom Leathercraft, model 205B. It has a synthetic leather palm, a stretch spandex back for airflow, and a padded knuckle area. A reinforced thumb panel and wing style wrist strap complete the design.
record.seo_title: CLC Custom Leathercraft 205B Mechanic Gloves, Large
record.meta_description: CLC Custom Leathercraft 205B engine crew mechanic's gloves in black, size large. Synthetic leather palm, padded knuckles and a reinforced thumb panel.
record.long_description: The CLC 205B Engine Crew glove is a mechanic's work glove in black, size large. The palm is made of Syntrex synthetic leather, and the back is a stretch spandex panel meant to let the hand breathe during longer jobs. Padding across the knuckles is designed to soften the impact of bumps against engine parts and tools. The thumb has a reinforced panel to hold up to repeated use. A wing style wrist strap closes the glove, and the listing describes it as easy to fasten with one hand. The glove is intended for mechanical and general shop work. The listing does not state a cut or puncture rating, so if you need protection against specific hazards, check the manufacturer's detailed specifications before buying.

record.description: A micronized DHEA dietary supplement from MRM, labeled at 50 mg with a count of 90 capsules. The listing says purity is checked using HPLC testing. Micronizing is described as improving absorption.
record.seo_title: MRM DHEA 50 mg Micronized Supplement, 90 Vcaps
record.meta_description: MRM micronized DHEA 50 mg dietary supplement in 90 Vcaps, with purity assured by HPLC testing as stated on the listing page.
record.long_description: MRM DHEA is a dietary supplement that provides 50 mg of micronized DHEA per labeled dose, packaged as 90 Vcaps. The listing describes DHEA as an adrenal hormone and says the micronized form is intended to be absorbed more readily. The product page also states that purity is assured by HPLC testing. The listing makes a number of wellness claims about energy, muscle, mood, weight and joint health. Those are the manufacturer's own statements and have not been verified here, so treat them as marketing rather than established fact. Because DHEA is a hormone precursor, a healthcare provider should be consulted before starting it, particularly for anyone who is pregnant, has a hormone-sensitive condition, or takes other medications. The label should be read in full before use.

record.description: Medium leather work gloves from Mechanix Wear in a brown and black colorway, model LFF-75-009. The listing describes them as anti-vibration gloves. They are made in the United States.
record.seo_title: Mechanix Wear DuraHide FastFit Leather Work Gloves
record.meta_description: Mechanix Wear DuraHide FastFit leather work gloves in medium, brown and black, model LFF-75-009. Listed as anti-vibration gloves made in the United States.
record.long_description: The Mechanix Wear DuraHide FastFit gloves are leather work gloves in a medium size, finished in brown and black. The model number is LFF-75-009. The listing presents them as anti-vibration gloves, which suggests they are intended for tasks that involve power tools or repeated impact. The gloves are made in the United States, according to the product details. The listing also identifies the glove as part of the DuraHide FastFit line and calls it a mechanics style glove. It does not give details on the leather grade, lining, or the exact level of vibration reduction, so buyers who need a specific performance level should confirm those details with the manufacturer. The listing also gives package dimensions, which may help with planning storage or shipping.

record.description: Men's silver metal sunglasses from Saint Laurent Eyewear, model SL135. The lenses are silver mirrored and the temples measure 145 mm. A protective designer case and cleaning cloth are included.
record.seo_title: Saint Laurent SL135 Men's Silver Mirrored Sunglasses
record.meta_description: Saint Laurent Eyewear SL135 men's metal sunglasses with silver mirrored lenses, 52 mm lens width and a case. Listed MSRP is $405.00.
record.long_description: These Saint Laurent Eyewear sunglasses for men are model SL135 and have a silver metal frame with silver mirrored lenses. The listing gives the temple length as 145 mm, the lens width as 52 mm and the bridge width as 22 mm, which are useful measurements when comparing frames with other eyewear. The glasses come with a protective designer case and a cleaning cloth. The listing shows a manufacturer's suggested retail price of $405.00. The product page does not describe lens category, UV rating or lens material, so if you need a specific level of sun protection, confirm those details before buying. The page is short, so the measurements and the included accessories are the main details to rely on.

record.description: A two pack of black poster frames in a 16 x 20 inch size. Each frame can hold a 16 x 20 inch photo without a mat, or an 11 x 14 inch photo behind a white mat. The frames use a plastic body with a plexiglass cover and can hang horizontally or vertically.
record.seo_title: ENJOYBASICS 16x20 Black Poster Frames, 2 Pack
record.meta_description: ENJOYBASICS black 16x20 poster frames, two pack. Shows a 16x20 photo unmatted or an 11x14 photo with a white mat, with plexiglass covers instead of glass.
record.long_description: The ENJOYBASICS frames come as a pair in a black finish and are sized 16 by 20 inches. Each frame can display a 16 by 20 inch print without a mat, or an 11 by 14 inch print when used with the included white mat. The body is plastic, and the cover is plexiglass rather than glass, which the listing presents as a safer choice in homes with children. The backing is designed to be released easily with a spring style clip, so the photo can be swapped in a few moments. The frames can be hung either horizontally or vertically, and the listing mentions they suit family photos, events, and gifts for occasions such as weddings and anniversaries. Each pair is wrapped in bubble wrap for shipping, and the listing names the set as a two pack.

specs.color modes: 120 colors plus RGB and warm white

record.description: A dimmable A19 LED bulb with an E26 base that changes color and also produces 10 watt warm white light. It ships with a remote and works with a standard wall switch. The listing also notes timer and night light use.
record.seo_title: LumenBasic A19 E26 10W Color Changing LED Bulb
record.meta_description: LumenBasic A19 E26 color changing LED bulb, 10W, with RGB and warm white modes, five dimming levels and a remote controller. Works with a wall switch.
record.long_description: The LumenBasic bulb is an A19 LED with an E26 base, so it fits standard Edison screw sockets. It can produce 120 colors through RGB and RGBWW modes, and it also has a warm white setting rated at 10 watts. The maker equates that white output to a 60 watt incandescent bulb. A remote controller comes with the bulb, and the listing says a standard wall switch can also control brightness. There are five dimming levels, five speeds for color changing and a timer function that can turn the bulb off automatically, which the listing suggests using as a night light. The bulb is intended for decorative lighting, party or mood lighting, and general room lighting. The listing also says the bulb remembers its last effect before it is switched off.

specs.care: Laundry bag, low temperature wash and iron

record.description: A vintage style floral lace swing dress from MISSMAY in black, size XX-Large. It has long sleeves, a boat neckline and an above knee hem, with a hidden zipper on the left side. The listing says the dress is stretchy and suited to evening and formal events.
record.seo_title: MISSMAY Women's Vintage Floral Lace Swing Dress
record.meta_description: MISSMAY women's black vintage floral lace swing dress in XX-Large, with long sleeves, boat neck and a hidden side zipper. Suited to cocktail and evening wear.
record.long_description: This MISSMAY swing dress is a black vintage style design with a floral lace overlay. It has long sleeves, a boat neckline and a hem that falls above the knee. A hidden zipper on the left side closes the dress. The listing describes the look as retro and elegant, and suggests it for evening events, cocktail parties, weddings and other formal occasions. The fabric is stretchy, so the listing asks buyers to check the size chart shown in the product photos rather than relying on a standard size. The size is listed as XX-Large, which corresponds to US 20 in the listing's size guide. For care, the listing asks buyers to place the dress in a laundry bag, wash it at a low temperature and iron it carefully on a low setting.

record.description: A short sleeve men's T-shirt from Carhartt in Umber Heather, size medium. The relaxed fit is made from a blend of polyester and cotton. The listing highlights moisture wicking, stain release and raglan sleeves for movement.
record.seo_title: Carhartt Force Cotton Delmont T-Shirt, Umber Heather
record.meta_description: Carhartt Force Cotton Delmont men's short sleeve T-shirt in Umber Heather, medium. Relaxed fit with a 60/40 polyester cotton blend and raglan sleeves.
record.long_description: The Carhartt Force Cotton Delmont is a men's short sleeve T-shirt in Umber Heather, size medium. It has a relaxed cut and is knit from a plaited jersey that the listing describes as 5.75 ounce weight. The fabric is 60 percent polyester and 40 percent cotton. Carhartt says the shirt uses fast drying technology that pulls sweat away from the body, and that the stain release treatment helps lift marks during washing. Raglan sleeves are cut to give the arms more freedom of movement. Because the listing describes the fit as relaxed, the shirt is intended to hang loosely rather than sit close to the body. Care instructions are not provided on the listing, so follow the label inside the garment when washing.

record.description: An indoor cell phone signal booster from weBoost, model 470103, rated to cover up to 5,000 square feet. It boosts 4G LTE and 3G signals and is listed as compatible with major US carriers. Installation components are included.
record.seo_title: weBoost Connect 4G Indoor Cell Phone Signal Booster
record.meta_description: weBoost Connect 4G indoor cell signal booster, model 470103, covers up to 5,000 square feet for 4G LTE and 3G. Lists compatibility with major US carriers.
record.long_description: The weBoost Connect 4G is an indoor cell phone signal booster for homes and offices, model 470103. The maker rates it for coverage of up to 5,000 square feet and says it can raise 4G LTE and 3G signal strength by as much as 32 times. The device uses automatic gain settings that adjust to the nearby signal, and it is powered by a standard 110 to 240 volt AC supply. The listing says all components needed for installation are included, and that the setup is designed for do-it-yourself installation. The booster is described as compatible with several US carriers, including AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, Sprint, Straight Talk and U.S. Cellular. The listing also states that US regulations prevent boosting one frequency used by part of the Sprint network, so some Sprint customers may not see the same gains as others. Check signal levels in your own location before buying.

record.description: A 7.4 volt, 2.2 Ah lithium-ion battery, model ASA14U01, made for Mobile Warming heated vests, jackets and gloves. It is described as lightweight and provides up to 10 hours of power. The battery has four adjustable heat levels.
record.seo_title: Mobile Warming ASA14U01 7.4V 2.2Ah Heated Battery
record.meta_description: Mobile Warming ASA14U01 7.4V 2.2Ah lithium-ion battery for heated vests, jackets and gloves. Offers up to 10 hours of power and four heat settings.
record.long_description: The Mobile Warming ASA14U01 is a replacement battery for heated clothing from the same brand. It is rated at 7.4 volts and 2.2 amp hours, and uses lithium-ion cells. The listing states that it is compatible with all Mobile Warming vests, jackets and gloves, which makes it an accessory rather than a complete heating system. The battery can provide up to 10 hours of power, depending on the heat setting selected. Four adjustable heat levels let the wearer choose a level, and LED indicators show the power status. The pack is operated by an easy push button, and the maker describes it as lightweight. The listing does not give the charging time or the exact dimensions, so review the product documentation before buying if you need those details.

specs.install: Under sink, DIY, no plumber required

record.description: An under sink reverse osmosis filter from Aquasana, model AQ-RO-3.55, with a kitchen faucet in brushed nickel. The system pairs reverse osmosis with a Claryum filter and remineralization. The listing says it reduces fluoride, chlorine and a long list of other contaminants.
record.seo_title: Aquasana AQ-RO-3.55 Under Sink Reverse Osmosis Filter
record.meta_description: Aquasana AQ-RO-3.55 under sink reverse osmosis filter with brushed nickel faucet. Combines RO, Claryum filtration and remineralization for drinking water.
record.long_description: The Aquasana AQ-RO-3.55 is an under sink reverse osmosis system that comes with a brushed nickel kitchen faucet, a storage tank and the first set of filters. The maker says it combines reverse osmosis with its Claryum filtration and a remineralization stage. The listing claims the system reduces 95 percent of fluoride, 97 percent of chlorine, and 99 percent of 86 other contaminants, including lead, mercury and asbestos. Replacement filters are designed to unscrew from the housing without disconnecting hoses or water lines. The package includes all parts needed for a do-it-yourself installation, and the listing says no plumber is required. The owner's manual should be reviewed before setup. The claims are the manufacturer's, and performance will depend on your local water quality and how often the filters are changed.

record.description: A white steel floor register diffuser from EZ-Flo, model 61638, with a 12 by 6 inch duct opening. An adjustable damper lets you regulate airflow. Two screws are included for mounting.
record.seo_title: EZ-Flo 61638 White Floor Register Diffuser, 12x6 Inch
record.meta_description: EZ-Flo 61638 white steel floor register diffuser with a 12 by 6 inch opening, a powder-coated finish and an adjustable damper. Two screws included.
record.long_description: The EZ-Flo 61638 is a floor register diffuser in white, designed to fit a duct opening of 12 by 6 inches. The overall unit measures 7.5 by 13.5 inches, so it covers the opening and the surrounding floor. It is made of heavy-duty steel, which the listing says gives the register strength for foot traffic. The powder-coated finish is described as resistant to flaking, scratching and fading. An adjustable damper lets you control how much air passes through, so you can balance airflow between rooms. Two screws are included for an easy installation. The listing does not specify the mounting depth or the type of duct it is designed for, so measure the existing duct opening before ordering. Opening the damper fully or partly is a simple way to change how much air reaches the room.

specs.includes: 2 front bucket, 1 rear bench, 4 headrest covers
specs.fit: Most cars, trucks, SUVs and vans

record.description: A full set of burgundy and black cloth seat covers from FH Group, model FH-FB050114. The set includes two front bucket covers, one rear bench cover and four headrest covers. It is designed to fit most cars, trucks, SUVs and vans and can be machine washed.
record.seo_title: FH Group Universal Fit Burgundy/Black Seat Covers
record.meta_description: FH Group universal fit full set cloth car seat covers in burgundy and black, model FH-FB050114. Includes front, rear and headrest covers for most vehicles.
record.long_description: This FH Group seat cover set is a universal fit kit in burgundy and black cloth, model FH-FB050114. It includes two covers for the front bucket seats, one for a rear bench and four for the headrests. The listing says the set fits almost all seats in cars, trucks, vans and SUVs. The fabric is described as durable, comfortable and breathable, and the maker says it is easy to clean in a washing machine and should be air dried. The rear bench cover is listed as fitting either a split or a non-split bench, but the listing notes that it cannot be used with seat features. The covers are marketed to protect an original seat or to hide wear on an older one. Measure your seats before ordering if you have a vehicle with unusual seat shapes.

specs.compartments: Main, side, mesh and small pockets

record.description: A black oxford fabric pencil case from Yonzone measuring 8.3 by 4.1 by 2.4 inches. It has a main compartment for pens and pencils and extra pockets for cards, cash and small cables. The listing says it also works as a travel or makeup bag.
record.seo_title: Yonzone Black Pencil Case, Large Oxford Pen Pouch
record.meta_description: Yonzone black oxford fabric pencil case with multiple compartments and sturdy zippers. Water resistant and sized 8.3 by 4.1 by 2.4 inches for school or office.
record.long_description: The Yonzone pencil case is a black oxford fabric pouch measuring 8.3 by 4.1 by 2.4 inches. The main compartment holds pencils and pens, while a side pocket is sized for cash or tickets. Mesh pockets hold small notes and cards, and smaller pockets suit cables, earbuds and chargers. The listing says the zippers are sturdy and the fabric resists scratches and dirt. The product is described as water resistant. Because of its layout, the listing presents it as useful for school, office desk organization, travel or a cosmetics bag. The maker recommends hand washing and natural air drying. The listing also mentions a money back guarantee and a lifetime service promise, but those are the seller's stated terms and should be checked at purchase.

record.description: A large purple nylon spatula from Homi Styles with a slotted, floral cut-out face. The head measures about 6 by 6.5 inches and the handle is stainless steel with a nylon grip. It is rated heat resistant up to 410 F and is not recommended for the dishwasher.
record.seo_title: Homi Styles Jumbo Nylon Spatula, Purple Non-Stick
record.meta_description: Homi Styles jumbo purple nylon spatula with a slotted floral face and stainless steel handle. Rated heat resistant up to 410 F for pancakes and cookies.
record.long_description: This Homi Styles spatula is an oversized kitchen turner in purple, measuring 15 inches end to end. The face is nylon and is listed at about 6 by 6.5 inches, which is large enough for pancakes, eggs, quesadillas and cookies. The face has a floral cut-out pattern that allows liquid and oil to drain off. The listing says the nylon is non-stick and will not hold residue, and that the head is flexible enough to scrape the bottoms of pans. The handle is stainless steel for strength and has a nylon grip with a hanging hole. The nylon is rated heat resistant up to 410 F. The listing advises against using the dishwasher and suggests hand washing. It is also covered by a money back guarantee stated by the seller.

record.description: A 32 oz electric hot pot from Proctor Silex in white, model 48507. It has adjustable heat settings from warm up to boiling and is used for tea, instant noodles, soups and oatmeal. The nonstick interior is easy to wash, and the product carries a one year limited warranty.
record.seo_title: Proctor Silex 32 oz Adjustable Electric Hot Pot, White
record.meta_description: Proctor Silex 32 oz adjustable temperature electric hot pot in white for tea, noodles and soup. Nonstick interior and a one year limited warranty.
record.long_description: The Proctor Silex 48507 is a 32 ounce electric hot pot in white. It is designed to heat water quickly for tea, pour over coffee, cocoa or oatmeal, and the listing says it can also warm canned soup or packaged noodles without using the stovetop. Heat can be set anywhere from warm up to a full boil, so the pot can serve different tasks. The interior has a nonstick surface that the maker says needs no soaking or scrubbing and can be cleaned with soap and dish detergent. The product includes a one year limited warranty and a customer support line that the maker describes as based in the US. Because the listing gives a capacity of 32 ounces, check that the amount suits your needs before buying. Read the instruction manual before the first use.

record.description: A twin pack of black steering wheel attachments from Orzly for Nintendo Switch Joy-Con controllers, meant for racing games such as Mario Kart 8 Deluxe. Each wheel holds a Joy-Con in its central panel. Joy-Con controllers are not included.
record.seo_title: Orzly Black Steering Wheel Twin Pack for Switch
record.meta_description: Orzly black steering wheel twin pack for Nintendo Switch Joy-Con controllers. Attaches for racing games like Mario Kart 8 Deluxe. Joy-Con not included.
record.long_description: The Orzly steering wheels are two black attachments that turn a pair of Nintendo Switch Joy-Con controllers into a racing wheel. Each wheel has a central panel into which a Joy-Con slides. The listing says either controller fits either wheel, and the black wheels are designed to suit any color of Joy-Con. The shoulder buttons are reachable through a built in mechanism, so the SL and SR buttons still work while the controller sits in the wheel. The wheel also has a reflective panel that shows the Joy-Con's own LED light pattern, so you can tell which player is connected. A hole at the back lets you remove the controller without pulling it out of the wheel. The listing states that the Joy-Con controllers themselves are not included and are shown only in the photos. The wheels are made for Nintendo Switch racing games, including Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.

record.description: A C-shaped end table from VASAGLE, model ULNT50X, with a particleboard top and steel frame. It can sit against a sofa or chair, or slide under a bed. Four wheels and four adjustable feet are included, so it can roll or stay put.
record.seo_title: VASAGLE C-Shaped End Table with Metal Frame, ULNT50X
record.meta_description: VASAGLE ULNT50X C-shaped end table with particleboard top and steel frame in rustic brown and black. Comes with casters and adjustable feet.
record.long_description: The VASAGLE ULNT50X is a C-shaped side table that can hug a sofa or chair, and the listing says it can also be tucked under a bed for storage. Its tabletop measures 19.7 by 13.8 inches and stands 21.7 inches tall without the wheels. The top is particleboard and the frame is steel, which the maker says provides durability and stability. The corners of the top are rounded for safety. The table is intended for use as an end table, a laptop surface, a dining spot or an occasional table. Assembly uses numbered parts and illustrated instructions. Four casters and four adjustable feet are both included, so you can choose wheels for moving the table or feet for keeping it fixed. The finish is listed as rustic brown and black, in an industrial style.

record.description: A stylized plush of Captain Brineybeard from the Cuphead video game, made by Funko. It stands about 6 inches tall and comes in multiple colors. The figure is meant to be collected and displayed alongside other Cuphead figures.
record.seo_title: Funko Plush Cuphead Captain Brineybeard Figure
record.meta_description: Funko Cuphead Captain Brineybeard stylized plush collectible, about 6 inches tall. Made for fans who collect and display Cuphead figures.
record.long_description: This Funko plush is a stylized figure of Captain Brineybeard, a character from the Cuphead video game. It stands about 6 inches tall and is made as a soft collectible rather than a figure with moving parts. The listing describes the piece as multicolored, matching the game's art style. Funko produces a range of Cuphead figures, and the listing invites buyers to collect and display them together. The listing also notes that the Funko Pop line was named toy of the year in 2017 and won a people's choice award. The plush is intended for fans of the game who want a display piece or a gift. The listing does not give the materials, the age range or the care instructions, so check the packaging for safety and age information before giving it to a young child.

record.description: An 8 inch black fry pan from T-fal, model C5610264. The forged, heavy gauge body has a titanium nonstick interior and a Thermo-Spot heat indicator. The riveted handles have a soft touch grip, and the pan is listed as dishwasher safe.
record.seo_title: T-fal C5610264 Titanium Nonstick 8 Inch Fry Pan
record.meta_description: T-fal C5610264 8 inch black fry pan with titanium nonstick interior, forged heavy gauge build and Thermo-Spot heat indicator. Dishwasher safe.
record.long_description: The T-fal C5610264 is an 8 inch fry pan in black, built with a forged, heavy gauge body that the listing describes as extra durable. The cooking surface is a titanium nonstick coating, and the pan is marked with a Thermo-Spot heat indicator that changes appearance when the surface reaches a set temperature, helping you know when to add food. The handles are riveted and have a soft touch grip, which the maker says keeps them comfortable to hold. The listing states that the pan is dishwasher safe, though hand washing will generally extend the life of any nonstick surface. The size and the single-pan format make it a practical option for eggs, small portions and everyday frying. The listing does not give a warranty term or compatibility with induction cooktops, so verify those before purchase.

specs.fit: Runs large, order one size down for snug fit

record.description: A one piece fleece bunting from Cuddle Club with a hood, fold-over mittens and booties. The asymmetrical zipper makes diaper changes easier. The listing says it runs oversized, so buy a size down for a snug fit.
record.seo_title: Cuddle Club Fleece Baby Bunting Bodysuit, Hooded
record.meta_description: Cuddle Club fleece baby bunting with hood, fold-over mittens, booties and an asymmetrical zipper. Washer friendly, in several animal styles.
record.long_description: This Cuddle Club bunting is a one piece fleece suit for babies and young children, with a hood, fold-over mittens and booties in the same piece. The asymmetrical zipper is designed to make diaper changes and dressing easier. The listing describes the fleece as soft and warm for cooler weather, and says the rollover cuffs can be folded to cover the hands and feet, which helps regulate warmth in different conditions. The product is available in several novelty styles, including bear, dinosaur, avocado, unicorn, astronaut, lion, monkey, penguin and koala. The listing notes that the suit runs oversized, so buyers who want a snug fit should order one size down. It is washer friendly, and the listing says the maker's products are built to last through repeated washing. The bunting is sold as a gift for holidays, birthdays and Halloween.

record.description: A pair of 10 foot hammock tree straps from Rallt with 18 loops each. The non-stretch polyester webbing is rated above 2,000 pounds combined and the kit weighs 11.7 ounces. Two aluminum wire gate carabiners are included.
record.seo_title: Rallt Hammock Tree Straps, 20 Ft Polyester Kit
record.meta_description: Rallt hammock tree straps with 36 loops, 20 feet total and non-stretch polyester webbing. Includes two carabiners and weighs 11.7 ounces for backpacking.
record.long_description: The Rallt hammock tree straps are a pair of 10 foot straps that give 20 feet of total length, with 18 loops on each strap for 36 attachment points. The webbing is 3/4 inch polyester, which the listing says will not stretch and will not sag overnight the way nylon can. The maker reports a combined breaking strength above 2,000 pounds and says each loop has a second bar tack stitch for extra security. Setup uses a daisy chain loop system: wrap the strap around the tree and clip the hammock carabiner into one of the loops. Reflective stitching is included to help with setup in the dark. Two aluminum wire gate carabiners come with the set. The straps pack into a small stuff sack and weigh 11.7 ounces, which suits backpacking and trips. The listing says the straps are compatible with many hammock brands, so check your hammock's carabiner size before buying.

record.description: A 7.5 foot artificial pine Christmas tree from ARTETHYS in green. The branches are PVC and the four leg metal stand is meant to keep the tree steady. The listing says it works indoors and outdoors and carries a one year warranty.
record.seo_title: ARTETHYS 7.5 Ft Artificial Christmas Tree, Green
record.meta_description: ARTETHYS 7.5 ft artificial Christmas tree with PVC pine branches and a sturdy four leg metal stand. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use with a 1-year warranty.
record.long_description: The ARTETHYS artificial Christmas tree is a 7.5 foot pine style tree in green. Its branches are PVC, formed to mimic the look of a full pine, and the listing says the branches can be fluffed into shape after unpacking. The tree is built in several sections for quick assembly, and the branches open outward. A solid four leg metal base provides a 30 inch wide footprint and helps the tree stay upright, and plastic feet covers are included to protect floors. The maker says the PVC is eco-friendly and non-toxic, and that the material passed a fire retardant test. The listing says the tree can be used indoors or outdoors and carries a one year warranty with customer service support. The listing gives two different tip counts for the tree, so confirm the exact figure with the seller before ordering. Ornaments and light strings are not included.

specs.sizes: Small, medium, large and double flange

record.description: Replacement ear tips from Earbudz, sold as eight pairs in black and clear. Each pair comes in small, medium, large or double flange sizes. They are listed to fit earbud posts from 4.0 to 4.5 mm, including several Powerbeats and Skullcandy models.
record.seo_title: Earbudz Replacement Ear Tips, 8 Pairs, Multi Size
record.meta_description: Earbudz replacement ear tips, 8 pairs in black and clear, small to double flange, for Powerbeats, Skullcandy and other earphones with 4.0 to 4.5 mm posts.
record.long_description: This Earbudz kit contains eight pairs of replacement ear tips, sixteen pieces in all, in both black and clear. Each size is available in small, medium, large and double flange styles, so you can choose the fit that suits your ear. The tips are listed to fit earbud posts between 4.0 and 4.5 millimeters. The listing says they are compatible with a long list of brands, including Powerbeats2 and Powerbeats3, several Skullcandy models, and products from Sony, JBL, Panasonic and Monster. Compatibility is not guaranteed for every model, and the listing notes that LG compatibility varies by model. The tips are described as removable, replaceable, durable and flexible. Buy a spare set if you want backups for lost, damaged or defective tips.

record.description: Women's slip on house slippers from ULTRAIDEAS in grey, size 9 to 10. They have a fleece lining, a high density memory foam insole and a non-slip rubber sole. The listing says they suit indoor and outdoor use and can be machine washed.
record.seo_title: ULTRAIDEAS Women's Memory Foam Slippers, Grey
record.meta_description: ULTRAIDEAS women's grey memory foam slippers with fleece lining and non-slip rubber sole, sizes 9 to 10. Machine washable for indoor and outdoor wear.
record.long_description: These ULTRAIDEAS slippers are women's house shoes in grey, listed for sizes 9 to 10. They slip on without laces and have a plush upper that imitates wool, with a fleece lining that the maker says cushions the foot. The insole is high density memory foam, which the listing says holds its shape and supports the foot as you walk. The rubber sole is non-slip and gives traction on smooth floors, and the listing says it can be used indoors and outdoors. The slippers are offered in several colors, including black, blue, pink and wine. The listing notes that a new pair may feel snug at first and will stretch to a more customized fit after several wears. For care, the slippers are machine washable. The description suggests them as a gift for family members and friends.

record.description: A men's compression undershirt from LARDROK in black, designed to smooth the chest and midsection under clothing. It is made from a stretchy blend and comes in sizes M to XXL. The listing says it has a back support panel.
record.seo_title: LARDROK Men's Compression Tummy Shaper Shirt, Black
record.meta_description: LARDROK men's black compression tummy shaper undershirt in sizes M to XXL. Stretch polyester, nylon and spandex blend with a back support panel.
record.long_description: This LARDROK undershirt is a compression garment for men in black. It is sold in sizes from M to XXL, and the listing gives chest measurements for each size, with a size M relaxed chest of 40 to 82 centimeters. The fabric is a knit blend of polyester, nylon and spandex, which the listing describes as breathable and close fitting. The shirt is designed to flatten the chest and smooth the stomach under other clothing, and it has a back panel that the maker says offers support for posture. It is also described as suitable for wearing under a formal shirt. The undershirt comes in black, white, gray and blue. The listing includes a satisfaction guarantee, and buyers should measure the chest before ordering because size charts vary from one brand to another.

specs.fitting: Harp or clip adapter, not included

record.description: A pure white linen lamp shade from IMISI that measures 9.3 inches across the bottom, 5.3 inches across the top and 7 inches tall. It is meant for a harp fitter or clip adapter, which are not included. The listing says the shade takes on a pink tint when the light is on.
record.seo_title: IMISI Pure White Linen Lamp Shade, 9.3 x 5.3 Inch
record.meta_description: IMISI pure white linen lamp shade, 9.3 inch bottom and 5.3 inch top diameter, 7 inches tall. Fits a harp or clip adapter sold separately.
record.long_description: The IMISI lamp shade is a white linen fabric shade for a table or floor lamp. It has a bottom diameter of 9.3 inches, a top diameter of 5.3 inches and a height of 7 inches, with a screw thread of about a quarter inch for mounting. The listing says it gives a soft, diffused light that suits a bedroom or a quiet corner. The linen is listed as pure white, and the maker notes the shade appears slightly pink when the lamp is on. The shade fits only a harp fitter or a clip adapter, and neither part comes with the purchase. The listing also advises against packing this shade with heavy items in the same order, because the shade can be crushed in transit. The design is described as simple and practical, and easy to pair with other furniture.

specs.use: Kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and laundry walls

record.description: Six 12 by 12 inch peel and stick tiles from Art3d with a marble look in grey and a shiny finish. The embossed resin surface is meant for kitchen and bathroom backsplashes. The tiles are heat and moisture resistant and can be wiped clean.
record.seo_title: Art3d 12 x 12 Inch Peel and Stick Backsplash Tile, Grey
record.meta_description: Art3d 12 x 12 inch peel and stick backsplash tiles in grey marble style, six sheets. Heat and moisture resistant for kitchen and bathroom walls.
record.long_description: The Art3d tiles are self-adhesive wall sheets, twelve inches square, sold as a pack of six. Each sheet has an embossed, shiny surface made of PU resin on an adhesive base, and the listing describes the design as a marble look in grey. Because the tiles are 12 inches square, the pack covers about 40 percent more area than the same count of 10 inch tiles. The maker says the sheets resist heat and moisture and can be wiped clean. They are intended for kitchen island walls, bathroom backsplashes, bedroom walls and laundry rooms. Installation involves cleaning and drying the wall, overlapping the edges and pressing each tile firmly into place. The listing warns that the tiles should not be exposed to flames, steam or water submersion, should not be used in a shower, and should not be placed within 16 inches of a stovetop. Rough or textured surfaces are not suitable.

specs.use: Head or neck support while reclining

record.description: A black leather neck pillow from Octane Seating for use while reclining. It is filled with high density blown fiber and covered in top grain leather. The back is non-slip to keep it in place, and the surface can be wiped with a damp cloth.
record.seo_title: Octane Seating Black Leather Recliner Neck Pillow
record.meta_description: Octane Seating black top grain leather recliner neck pillow with high density blown fiber fill and a non-slip back. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.
record.long_description: The Octane Seating neck pillow is a single black leather cushion made to support the head or neck while you recline in a chair. The shape is ergonomic, which the listing says helps the pillow fit the curve of the neck. The filling is high density premium blown fiber, which should hold its shape through regular use. The outer covering is top grain leather, and the back uses a non-slip material so the pillow stays in place on the chair. The listing does not state the leather grade beyond top grain or the exact dimensions, so check the product page if you need precise measurements. For cleaning, the listing recommends wiping the surface with a damp cloth. The pillow is sold as a pack of one and is intended for use with recliners and reclining seats.

record.description: A round molded wood toilet seat from Luxury Home Fashion in black. It fits most standard round toilets and comes with hinges and installation hardware. The listing describes the seat as sturdy and says it suits an elegant or rustic bathroom.
record.seo_title: Luxury Home Fashion Black Round Wood Toilet Seat
record.meta_description: Luxury Home Fashion black round molded wood toilet seat for most standard toilets. Hinges and installation hardware included, with an elegant or rustic look.
record.long_description: This Luxury Home Fashion toilet seat is a round replacement seat in black, made from molded wood. The listing says it fits most standard round toilets and includes the hinges and installation material needed to mount it. The seat is described as comfortable and sturdy, and the cover is designed to add either an elegant or a rustic look to a bathroom. The listing notes that the seat adds functionality and durability as well as style. Because the fit is described for standard round toilets, measure the bowl and check the mounting holes of your fixture before you buy. The listing does not state the wood species or the finish type, so confirm those details with the seller if they matter to you.

specs.hands: Black hour and minute, red second

record.description: A radio-controlled wall clock from Chicago Lighthouse, model ILC67403306. It sets its own time each day and changes the hour hand for daylight saving in spring and fall. The white face has large Arabic numerals and a UV protected lens.
record.seo_title: Chicago Lighthouse Atomic Radio-Controlled Wall Clock
record.meta_description: Chicago Lighthouse atomic wall clock, model ILC67403306, with radio-controlled movement, UV-protected lens and large Arabic numerals on a white face.
record.long_description: The Chicago Lighthouse atomic wall clock is model ILC67403306, a contemporary design intended for large work spaces where accurate time matters. Its radio-controlled movement corrects the time once a day, so you do not need to set it by hand after installation. The hour hand is adjusted automatically for the spring and fall clock changes. The clock has a white face that the maker says will not yellow, with large Arabic numerals and black hour and minute hands. The second hand is red. The lens is UV protected, which the listing says helps the face keep its appearance over time. Because the clock depends on a radio signal, the listing does not promise reception in every building, so place it where you can confirm that it synchronizes. The listing does not state the dimensions or the battery type.

specs.features: Pockets and attached fur ear hood

record.description: A men's costume jumpsuit from Leg Avenue in black and white, size X-Large. It has a fur print pattern, a double sided zipper, pockets and an attached hood with fur ears. The listing positions it for Halloween and theme parties.
record.seo_title: Leg Avenue Men's Fur Print Costume Jumpsuit, XL
record.meta_description: Leg Avenue men's black and white fur print costume jumpsuit in X-Large. Includes pockets, a double zipper and an attached fur ear hood for Halloween.
record.long_description: This Leg Avenue costume is a men's jumpsuit in a black and white fur print, sized X-Large. The double sided zipper runs the length of the front so the suit can be put on and taken off with ease. Pockets are built into the suit, and the hood is attached and finished with fur ears. The listing says the material is soft and comfortable and that the costume is durable and long lasting. It is positioned for Halloween, theme parties and similar events, where a playful animal style costume would fit. Because it is a costume rather than everyday clothing, the listing does not give a fiber content or care instructions. Check the label inside the garment before washing, and allow for the fur print when choosing a size.

record.description: A set of two orange grommet top curtain panels from Blackout 365, each measuring 40 by 84 inches. The panels are described as room darkening, thermal insulating, noise reducing and privacy protecting. They can be machine washed and dried.
record.seo_title: Blackout 365 Ashmont Grommet Curtains, Orange, 40x84
record.meta_description: Blackout 365 Ashmont orange grommet top curtain panels, set of 2 at 40 by 84 inches. Room darkening and thermal insulated for living rooms and bedrooms.
record.long_description: The Blackout 365 Ashmont curtains are a set of two panels in an orange geometric pattern, each measuring 40 inches wide by 84 inches long. The grommet top lets the panels slide onto a curtain rod with no separate hooks. The listing says the panels are high performance, with room darkening, thermal insulation, noise reduction and privacy protection. Several pattern colors are offered, and the listing asks buyers to use the color button to view the reference images. The panels can be machine washed and dried. The maker says they will not shrink, fade or unravel after washing. The listing covers living rooms and bedrooms, and buyers should measure their window and rod before ordering to confirm the length and coverage they need.

specs.fit: Big and tall, regular through thigh

record.description: Men's big and tall 502 regular taper jeans from Levi's in a rosefinch color, sized 48W by 32L. The jeans have a regular fit through the thigh and a slightly tapered leg opening. The fabric is cotton with a small amount of elastane for stretch.
record.seo_title: Levi's Men's Big & Tall 502 Taper Jeans, Rosefinch
record.meta_description: Levi's men's big and tall 502 regular taper jeans in rosefinch, 48W x 32L. A 98% cotton and 2% elastane denim with a zip fly and five pockets.
record.long_description: These Levi's 502 jeans are part of the brand's big and tall range, in a rosefinch color and sized 48 by 32. The 502 is a classic taper style that sits below the waist. It has a regular fit through the thigh and a slightly tapered leg opening, with extra room in the leg for comfort. The denim is 98 percent cotton and 2 percent elastane, which the listing says provides a comfortable fit with some stretch. The jeans have a zip fly and five pocket styling. The listing says the brand has made clothing for more than 150 years and describes the jeans as a modern wardrobe staple. For care, the listing recommends machine washing the jeans inside out with like colors, using liquid detergent.

record.description: Lunar Blue colored cardstock from Astrobrights, item 22721, with 250 sheets per pack. Each sheet measures 8.5 by 11 inches and weighs 65 pound, or 176 GSM. The listing names Neenah Wausau Paper as the manufacturer.
record.seo_title: Astrobrights Lunar Blue Cardstock, 8.5 x 11 Inch, 250
record.meta_description: Astrobrights Lunar Blue colored cardstock, item 22721, a 250 sheet pack at 8.5 by 11 inches and 65 lb (176 GSM) weight, made by Neenah Wausau Paper.
record.long_description: This pack holds 250 sheets of Lunar Blue colored cardstock from the Astrobrights line, catalog item 22721. Each sheet is 8.5 by 11 inches, the standard letter size used for printers and home projects. The cardstock weighs 65 pounds, which is 176 grams per square meter, making it heavier than ordinary copy paper. The listing names Neenah Wausau Paper as the manufacturer. The sheets have a bright blue color that the listing names Lunar Blue. The listing does not describe a recommended printer type or finish, so check the manufacturer details before use in a machine that may be sensitive to heavier stock. The pack is a bulk option for buyers who need a large quantity of one color, since every sheet in the pack matches.

record.description: Camo green PLA filament for 3D printing, sized at 1.75 mm. It suits many popular desktop printer models and extrudes at temperatures between 190 and 220 degrees Celsius. Each spool holds about 2.2 pounds and is made in the United States.
record.seo_title: Solutech Camo Green PLA 3D Printer Filament
record.meta_description: Camo green 1.75 mm PLA filament from Solutech for desktop 3D printers. Prints at 190 to 220 C and comes in a 2.2 lb spool made in the USA.
record.long_description: This camo green filament is a PLA material sized at 1.75 mm, a diameter used by many desktop 3D printers. The listing names several machine families it is meant for, including MakerBot, RepRap, FlashForge, and Solidoodle models, and says it can also work with other printers of a similar type. Printing temperatures sit between 190 and 220 degrees Celsius, so you will want your extruder set within that window. The spool holds about 2.2 pounds, or one kilogram, of filament. The maker reports a dimensional accuracy of plus or minus 0.03 millimeters, and the product is made in the United States. Printer models differ in their nozzle and bed settings, so check your machine manual before starting a print. If you want a camouflage look on printed parts, this color is the one the listing offers.

specs.strength: Up to 3X stronger than conventional hooks

record.description: A 48 inch bungee cord with a carabiner hook that has a spring gate to hold it in place. The molded grip is oversized for a secure hold, and the outer jacket resists UV exposure. The maker says the hook is stronger than conventional designs.
record.seo_title: KEEPER 48 inch Super Duty Bungee Cord with Hook
record.meta_description: KEEPER 48 inch bungee cord with a carabiner hook and spring gate. Oversized molded grip and UV resistant outer jacket for securing loads.
record.long_description: This 48 inch bungee cord has a carabiner style hook at one end, with a spring gate that the listing says keeps the hook seated in place. The grip on the hook is oversized and molded, which the maker presents as a way to hold firmly and securely. The listing describes the hook as up to three times stronger than conventional hooks. The outer jacket is UV resistant, so the cord is suited to outdoor use where sunlight would otherwise wear down a standard cord. A general purpose bungee like this one is typically used for securing items, and the listing does not name a specific job for it. Because the listing gives no load rating, check the cord details against the task you have in mind before relying on it for heavy loads. The product is sold under the KEEPER name.

specs.models: Assorted Pro V1 and Pro V1X

record.description: A set of 72 recycled Titleist golf balls, mixing assorted Pro V1 and Pro V1X models from different years. The balls are washed and cleaned, and they are listed in fair to good condition. They come in a drawstring mesh bag for storage.
record.seo_title: Titleist Recycled Pro V1 Golf Balls, 72 Pack
record.meta_description: Titleist recycled Pro V1 and Pro V1X golf balls, 72 mixed models in a drawstring mesh bag. Listed in fair to good condition and washed clean.
record.long_description: This lot contains 72 golf balls that are recycled, mixing assorted Pro V1 and Pro V1X models from different years. The seller says each ball has been washed and cleaned, and the condition is listed as fair to good rather than new. Because the balls come from several production years, they will not all match one another. A drawstring mesh bag holds the set, which keeps the collection together for storage or transport. The listing presents these balls as a lower cost option compared with new Pro V1 balls, noting savings of up to 80 percent off the new price. Used balls of this kind are a practical choice for practice rounds, casual play, or golfers who want to try the Pro V1 line without paying full price. Because the condition is listed as fair to good, some wear from earlier play should be expected.

specs.contents: Duvet cover and 2 pillow shams, no comforter

record.description: A queen size reversible duvet cover set made from 600 thread count cotton with a teal blue leaf print. The set includes one duvet cover and two pillow shams, and a comforter is not included. Button closures and corner ties help keep the comforter in place. The fabric is machine washable.
record.seo_title: SLEEPBELLA Teal Leaf Queen Duvet Cover Set
record.meta_description: SLEEPBELLA queen duvet cover set in teal blue leaf print, 600 thread count cotton. Includes one duvet cover and two pillow shams, comforter not included.
record.long_description: This queen size duvet cover set is made from 600 thread count cotton and features a teal blue leaf print. The print is reversible, so you can switch the pattern between the front and back of the cover. The set includes one duvet cover and two pillow shams, sized to suit a queen bed. The duvet cover has a button closure, and ties at the four corners help hold the comforter in place. A comforter is not included with this set. The seller describes the cotton as soft and says the fabric holds up through repeated machine washing and drying without shrinking, fading, or tearing easily. The listing says the cover gets softer after each wash. Listed dimensions are 90 by 90 inches for the duvet cover and 20 by 26 inches for each sham, so the set suits anyone wanting a botanical look on a queen bed.

record.description: Two-ply paper towels made from 100 percent recycled paper, sold as two packs of six rolls for twelve rolls total. Each roll has about 140 sheets, and the sheets tear off in sizes you can adjust to the mess. Whitening is done without chlorine bleach, and dye and fragrance are not added.
record.seo_title: Seventh Generation 2-Ply Recycled Paper Towels
record.meta_description: Seventh Generation 2-ply paper towels made from recycled paper, 12 rolls total in two 6-roll packs with about 140 sheets per roll.
record.long_description: These two-ply paper towels are made from recycled paper, and the sheets are whitened without chlorine bleach. Each roll contains about 140 sheets, and this listing ships twelve rolls total in two packs of six. The sheets can be torn off in amounts that suit small or large spills, which the seller presents as a way to use only what you need. Dye and fragrance are not added to the towels. The brand says it is guided by the idea of caring for the next seven generations, and the listing reflects that focus. Paper towels with this kind of construction are commonly used for kitchen cleanup, drying hands, and general household messes. The listing describes the sheets as strong and absorbent. With 140 sheets on each of twelve rolls, the order holds roughly 1,680 sheets in total.

specs.fasteners: Hook and loop on all four sides

record.description: A four-panel folding gym mat that unfolds to 4 by 10 feet and is 2 inches thick. It is padded with dense EPE foam and covered in waterproof PU leather that wipes clean. Hook and loop fasteners on the ends let you join more mats, and hand straps make it easier to carry.
record.seo_title: Giantex 4x10 ft Folding Gymnastics Mat, Pink Blue
record.meta_description: Giantex 4 by 10 foot folding gymnastics mat with 2 inch EPE foam and waterproof PU leather cover. Joins with other mats and folds for storage.
record.long_description: This folding gymnastics mat is 4 feet wide and 10 feet long, and it is two inches thick when unfolded. It has four panels that fold together for storage, and the listing gives a folded size of 4 feet by 2.5 feet by 8 inches. The mat is filled with EPE foam and covered in PU leather that the seller describes as waterproof and easy to clean. Hook and loop fasteners on each end let the mat connect to other mats. Hand straps on the sides make it easier to carry. The listing says the mat suits tumbling, yoga, aerobics, Pilates, dance, and martial arts, and that it works for schools, clubs, and home use. The mat weighs nine pounds and is offered in pink and blue. The listing also says the mat can be laid flat and used as a seat.

specs.fit: Fits mattresses up to 15 inch deep
specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A fitted bottom sheet in Twin XL, measuring 39 by 80 inches, with deep pockets for mattresses up to 15 inches deep. It is made from a soft, lightweight fleece described as plusher than flannel and resistant to pilling. It is machine washable in cold water.
record.seo_title: Bare Home Twin XL Fleece Fitted Sheet, Grey
record.meta_description: Bare Home twin XL grey fleece fitted sheet, 39 by 80 inches with 15 inch deep pockets. Soft, lightweight, and machine washable in cold water.
record.long_description: This fitted sheet is sized for a twin extra long bed and measures 39 by 80 inches. Its elastic fitting is designed to hug mattresses up to 15 inches deep, and it is made from a soft fleece that the seller describes as plusher than flannel. The fabric is presented as lightweight and warm, suitable for cold seasons as well as year round use. The fleece is said to resist pilling, so it should keep its appearance over time. specs.fan: Zero RPM mode at low to medium load

record.description: A men's right hand driver with a 9 degree loft, a graphite shaft in regular flex, and a black and light grey head. The head is forged from aluminum and built to promote a right to left ball flight. It uses a thru slot speed pocket and a speed injected twist face.

record.meta_description: TaylorMade SiM 2 Max Draw men's right hand driver, 9 degree loft, graphite regular shaft, forged aluminum head with draw bias design.

The speed injected twist face is calibrated to the legal limit and includes corrective face curvature to help with heel and toe mis-hits. The listing notes that draw bias designs trade some forgiveness for a right to left ball flight, so check the specs before buying.

record.description: A three pack of travel plug adapters that let US plugs connect to outlets in many European countries. Each has two US outlets and two USB ports with 2.4 amps total output. The adapter is rated for 3750 W at 250 V and 15 A, and it is not a voltage converter.
