record.meta_description: Small red cotton Christmas hats that fit over lollipops and candy pops. Reusable and lightweight, they suit holiday parties and seasonal treat tables.
record.long_description: These mini Christmas hats are made to dress up lollipops and other candy pops for holiday parties and seasonal gatherings. Each hat is made of cotton, which keeps it soft and light enough to sit on a candy without weighing it down. The hats are small, about 2.36 by 1 by 1 inches according to the listing, and the seller describes them as reusable, so you can keep them for future events. The listing also suggests sharing them with friends, since the package holds enough for more than one occasion. Because they are simple decorations, they can work for classroom treats, office parties, or themed tables where a festive touch is wanted. The red color suits the Christmas theme. The listing gives different piece counts in different places, so check the package details before buying if the exact number matters to you.

record.description: A five panel set of framed canvas prints showing an abstract ocean and beach sunset. The canvases are stretched over wooden frames and arrive ready to hang, with a hook already attached to each panel. The set is sized to hang as a group.
record.seo_title: EPHANY Art Five Piece Ocean Sunset Canvas Wall Art
record.meta_description: Five piece canvas wall art of an abstract ocean sunset, stretched on wood frames with hooks attached. Ready to hang in living rooms, bedrooms, and offices.
record.long_description: This five piece wall art set brings an ocean sunset scene into a room with a relaxed, abstract look. The prints are reproduced on canvas and stretched over wooden frames, so each panel can be hung without extra mounting work. Each piece already has a hook fixed to its back bar, which the listing says makes hanging easier right out of the box. The panels are different sizes and together measure about 40 by 20 inches, so you can arrange them as a group on a wall. The seller lists living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, hotel rooms, dining rooms, and bathrooms as places to hang them. The listing also presents the artwork as a gift option for relatives and friends. The listing does not name a color scheme beyond the sunset and ocean theme, so check the images before buying if you need a specific palette. The seller also offers a satisfaction guarantee and asks buyers to get in touch with questions.

record.description: A 3.5 quart digital air fryer with a 1400 watt heater and a fan that circulates hot air to cook food with little or no oil. It has timer and temperature controls and six cooking functions for frying, baking, grilling, and roasting.
record.seo_title: Elite Gourmet EAF-1506D 3.5 Quart Digital Air Fryer
record.meta_description: A 3.5 quart digital air fryer with 1400 watts, six cooking functions, and a 60 minute timer. Cook with little oil in a non-stick, PFOA and PTFE free basket.
record.long_description: This countertop air fryer is designed to cook meals with much less oil than deep frying. A high powered fan moves hot air around the food in a basket with a non-stick, PFOA and PTFE free coating, which the listing says gives a crisp finish. The basket holds about 3.5 quarts, or roughly 2.5 pounds of food, enough for a family sized batch. Six preset functions cover frying, baking, grilling, and roasting, and the temperature range runs from 149 to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. A 60 minute timer shuts the unit off when the cycle ends. The listing mentions a cool touch handle that helps when lifting out hot food, and a booklet with 26 recipes is included to get you started. The exterior is described as easy to keep clean with a damp cloth. The unit is black and draws 1400 watts of power.

specs.face: Hard water resistant, easy to clean

record.description: A single function wall mount showerhead that uses Katalyst air induction to build a fuller spray at 2.5 gallons per minute. The face resists hard water buildup and is easy to wipe clean. The finish is polished chrome.
record.seo_title: KOHLER K-10282 Forte Wall Mount Showerhead, Chrome
record.meta_description: Kohler wall mount showerhead with Katalyst air induction spray at 2.5 gallons per minute. Polished chrome finish with a hard water resistant, easy clean face.
record.long_description: This wall mounted showerhead from Kohler offers one spray function and uses air induction to build a fuller stream. Air is mixed into the water flow, which the listing says creates larger drops that spread across the body. The flow rate is 2.5 gallons per minute. The spray face is designed to fight hard water deposits, and the listing says it is easy to clean. The finish is polished chrome, a bright metallic look. The model number is K-10282-AK-CP, which helps when you need to confirm the exact product. The listing does not describe installation steps or the hardware included, so review the packaging before buying. For someone who wants a steady, air mixed spray with a single setting, this model covers the basic need. It is a straightforward showerhead that suits a standard shower setup.

record.description: Men's black recovery compression socks with graduated 20 to 30 mmHg compression. They have padding around the heel and Achilles, and a blend of nylon and elastane for stretch. The listing aims them at recovery after running, cycling, or long days on the feet.
record.seo_title: CEP Men's Recovery Compression Socks, Black
record.meta_description: Men's black recovery compression socks with graduated 20 to 30 mmHg compression, a padded heel, and a nylon and elastane blend for stretch and comfort.
record.long_description: These recovery socks are made for men who want graduated compression after running, cycling, or other hard workouts. The listing describes a 20 to 30 mmHg compression level that is meant to ease from the ankle toward the calf. The socks are 85 percent polyamide and 15 percent elastane, and the seller says the synthetic fibers are lightweight and breathable so the skin stays dry. Padding around the heel and Achilles tendon is meant to add comfort through a long day, which the listing suggests is useful for travel or time spent on your feet at work. The brand presents the socks for people recovering from injuries or dealing with swelling, though these are marketing claims rather than medical advice. If you have a medical condition, it is worth asking a clinician whether compression socks are right for you. The socks are black and are part of the CEP recovery line.

specs.added ingredients: Botanical oat milk, soy protein, argan oil

record.description: A permanent hair color creme in shade 7.5 Almond Brown, made to be gentle on the scalp and free from PPD, ammonia, alcohol, and silicone. It is intended for even color from root to tip and up to 100 percent gray coverage.
record.seo_title: Schwarzkopf Simply Color 7.5 Almond Brown Hair Color
record.meta_description: Schwarzkopf Simply Color permanent hair dye in shade 7.5 Almond Brown. Free from PPD, ammonia, and silicone, with up to 100 percent gray coverage.
record.long_description: This permanent hair color creme is a medium brown shade called Almond Brown, labeled 7.5 on the box. The brand says the formula was tested by dermatologists and is non irritating to the skin. It is free from PPD, ammonia, alcohol, and silicone. Botanical oat milk, soy protein, and argan oil are part of the formula, which the listing presents as a way to keep hair looking healthy during coloring. The product aims for color that is even from the roots through the ends, with a vibrant finish. The creme is labeled for up to 100 percent gray coverage and long lasting color. The listing advises buyers with hair longer than shoulder length to use two boxes for a full application. Read the enclosed instructions and do a patch test before first use, as with any hair dye. Your result will depend on your starting hair color, so the final shade may differ from the swatch.

record.description: A one gallon semi-gloss floor finish with a GREENGUARD Certified rating and VOC levels that meet SCAQMD requirements. The listing gives coverage of 500 to 600 square feet per gallon and a dry time of two to three hours.
record.seo_title: Bona Mega Semi-Gloss Floor Finish, 1 Gallon
record.meta_description: Bona Mega semi-gloss floor finish in a one gallon container. GREENGUARD Certified, covers 500 to 600 square feet per gallon, and dries in two to three hours.
record.long_description: Bona Mega is a semi-gloss floor finish sold in a one gallon container. The listing gives a coverage range of about 500 to 600 square feet per gallon, so one container can handle a medium sized room. Expect roughly two to three hours of dry time before the surface is ready for light use. The product carries a GREENGUARD Certified mark, and the seller notes that its VOC levels meet South Coast Air Quality Management District requirements, which matters for indoor air when you are choosing a finish. The listing gives a solids content of 0.325. The country of origin is listed as Sweden, though the seller notes this may change. Follow the label directions for application and cleanup, and ventilate the room while the finish dries. Because the listing focuses on coverage and certification, check the manufacturer's instructions for your surface before starting a project.

specs.set: Hair cutting shear and thinning shear with bag

record.description: A set of professional hair cutting and thinning shears with black coated blades made from Japanese 440C stainless steel. The offset handles and adjustable tension screw are meant for comfortable use in long sessions. A carrying bag is included.
record.seo_title: Purple Dragon 440C Japanese Hair Cutting Shear Set
record.meta_description: Purple Dragon hair cutting and thinning shear set with a black coated blade, Japanese 440C stainless steel, offset handles, and a carrying bag for salon use.
record.long_description: This two shear set includes a hair cutting scissor and a thinning scissor, both aimed at salon and barber work. The blades are made of Japanese 440C stainless steel, which the listing rates at HRC62 hardness. The coating on the blades is described as abrasion resistant, and the seller says the finish suits people with nickel sensitivities. Each shear has an offset handle with a shorter thumb grip than finger grip, which the listing says is meant to reduce wrist strain during longer sessions. An adjustable screw lets you set the tension for smooth opening and closing. The listing says the shears cut without dragging or splitting hair ends, and the lengths of roughly 5.5 to 6 inches suit most cutting work. A carrying bag is included. The seller also advises storing the scissors in a dry place away from humidity and keeping them out of reach of children, since they are very sharp.

specs.playback: Up to 30 hours music, 3.5 hours video

record.description: A renewed Apple iPod nano with 16GB of storage in pink, model MKMV2LL/A. The listing says the unit was inspected and tested by Amazon qualified suppliers and comes with a 90 day supplier warranty. Music playback is rated at up to 30 hours.
record.seo_title: Apple iPod nano 16GB Pink, Renewed
record.meta_description: Renewed Apple iPod nano eighth generation in pink with 16GB of storage. Tested and inspected, with up to 30 hours of music playback and a 90-day warranty.
record.long_description: This is a renewed Apple iPod nano, eighth generation, with 16GB of storage in a pink finish. Renewed units are pre owned products that the seller says have been inspected and tested, with defective parts replaced and a full cleaning, though packaging and accessories may be generic. The listing says the unit comes with a minimum 90 day supplier backed warranty. The device has a 240 by 432 pixel display, a frequency response from 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz, and music playback of up to 30 hours, with video playback of up to 3.5 hours. To sync with a computer, the listing states that a Mac needs a USB 2 or 3 port and OS X 10.7.5 or later, while a PC needs a USB 2 port, Windows 7 or later, and iTunes 12.2 or later. Check that your computer meets these requirements before buying.

specs.sizing: US standard, size up for loose fit

record.description: A pullover hoodie with a bold geometric print in black and white, a drawstring hood, and a front kangaroo pocket. The print is applied with digital printing. Sizing follows US standards, and the listing suggests ordering one size up for a looser fit.
record.seo_title: RAISEVERN Geometric Drawstring Hoodie, Black
record.meta_description: Hoodie with a black and white geometric print, drawstring hood, and front kangaroo pocket. Machine or hand washable. Order one size up for a looser fit.
record.long_description: This pullover hoodie has a bold geometric print in black and white and a lively, playful style. The seller positions it as a casual piece for parties, festivals, gifts, and everyday wear. The hood has a drawstring, and the front has a kangaroo pocket for a phone, keys, or a wallet. The cuffs are tight, which the listing says helps keep wind out. The print is produced with digital printing, and the listing says the surface has no attached parts and has good air permeability. Care is machine or hand washing. The seller uses the US standard size chart, so check the listing before ordering and consider the suggestion to choose one size up if you want a looser fit. The listing says the hoodie suits women, men, boys, and girls, and it lists travel, work, study, outdoor sports, and holiday events as possible uses.

specs.footbed: EVA with concealed orthotic arch support

record.description: A women's toe post flip-flop sandal in black, with a suede upper, rhinestone accents, and a concealed orthotic arch support. The listing says it has an EVA footbed and an APMA Seal of Acceptance. The size is 9 medium US.
record.seo_title: Vionic Women's Tide Rhinestone Toe Post Sandal
record.meta_description: Vionic Tide Rhinestones toe post sandal in black, with a suede upper, rhinestone accents, and concealed orthotic arch support. Women's size 9 medium US.
record.long_description: This sandal from Vionic belongs to the Tide family and uses a toe post design in a flip-flop style. The upper is suede, and the strap is decorated with rhinestones for a bit of sparkle, while the colorway is a classic black. The footbed is made of EVA and has a concealed orthotic arch support, which the brand says was designed by a podiatrist to promote stability from the ground up. The listing says the sandal has received the APMA Seal of Acceptance from the American Podiatric Medical Association. This is a women's size 9 medium in US sizing. The seller describes Vionic footwear as a blend of biomechanics and current styles. The sandal suits errands, walking, and casual outings for anyone who wants arch support in a simple, easy to wear shoe.

specs.compartments: Main zip compartment with 2 separators, 2 front pockets, 2 side pockets
specs.straps: Adjustable padded mesh with chest strap and whistle buckle

record.description: A packable 35 liter daypack in orange that folds into its own pocket and weighs about 0.7 pound. It has a main zip compartment, front and side pockets, padded mesh shoulder straps, and a chest strap with a whistle buckle. A lifetime warranty is listed.
record.seo_title: Venture Pal 35L Packable Hiking Daypack, Orange
record.meta_description: Venture Pal orange packable daypack, 35 liters and about 0.7 pound, with a fold into pocket, tear and water resistant fabric, and a lifetime warranty.
record.long_description: This lightweight daypack folds into its own pocket, so it can be stowed in a suitcase and used as a carry on for extra baggage. The listing gives a capacity of 35 liters and a weight of about 0.7 pound. The fabric is described as tear and water resistant, with a double layer bottom panel and bar tacked stress points for extra strength when carrying heavier loads. The shoulder straps are breathable mesh with padding and can be adjusted in length, and a chest strap with a whistle buckle helps hold the pack in place. The main compartment is zipped and includes two separators for organizing items. Two front zipped pockets hold small accessories, and two side pockets fit water bottles or umbrellas. The seller offers a lifetime warranty that covers exchange or return. The pack is orange and suits hiking, travel, and day trips.

specs.pockets: 1 internal and 1 external fully insulated pocket

record.description: A soft cooler made from 600 denier water resistant fabric with dense thermal insulation. It has one internal and one external fully insulated pocket, two mesh beverage sleeves, and a carrying strap. The listing describes the materials as BPA free and lead free.
record.seo_title: Husky 600D Insulated Cooler with Mesh Sleeves
record.meta_description: Husky soft cooler with 600 denier fabric, insulated inner and outer pockets, two mesh beverage sleeves, and a carrying strap. BPA free and lead free.
record.long_description: This insulated cooler is built for carrying food and drinks in a soft sided bag. The shell is made from 600 denier spun tuff fabric that the listing describes as heavy duty and water resistant. The thermal insulation is dense, and the bag has two insulated pockets, one inside the main space and one on the outside, both meant to keep contents hot or cold. A separate external pocket on the back and two mesh beverage sleeves give extra room for small items and drinks. The bag comes with a carrying strap. The listing states that the materials are BPA free and lead free. The model number 82021N11 identifies the product. The listing does not give the interior capacity or the color, so check those details against the product photos or the seller's specifications before you buy.

record.description: An outdoor American flag made in the USA from 200 denier heavyweight nylon, with embroidered stars and sewn stripes. It has multi row lock stitching at the hems, rust proof grommets, and a roped heading. The colors use SolarGuard dyes for sun protection.
record.seo_title: Annin Model 2320 Made in USA Outdoor American Flag
record.meta_description: Annin outdoor American flag made in the USA with 200 denier nylon, embroidered stars, rust proof grommets, and SolarGuard dyes for UV protection.
record.long_description: This outdoor flag is made by Annin, which the listing says has been producing American flags since 1847. Production takes place in factories in South Boston, Virginia, and Coshocton, Ohio. The flag is built from 200 denier heavyweight nylon, with 50 embroidered stars and 13 sewn stripes. Multiple rows of lock stitching reinforce the hems and are meant to resist wind and shredding. The edges use rust proof grommets, and the heading is roped with a galvanized thimble. The printed colors use SolarGuard dyes, which the listing says are processed for sun protection. The listing describes the flag as suited to homeowners, businesses, schools, and municipalities, and says it is built for industrial, institutional, and commercial display. The size is given inconsistently in the listing, with the title and bullets showing different dimensions, so confirm the measurements before ordering.

record.description: A pink rugged case for 10.2 inch iPad models in the 7th, 8th, and 9th generations. It has a polycarbonate backplate, a built in screen protector, and a pop out kickstand. The cutouts leave ports, sensors, speakers, and cameras accessible.
record.seo_title: SUPCASE Pink Rugged iPad 10.2 Case with Kickstand
record.meta_description: Pink rugged SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro case for the 10.2 inch iPad 7th, 8th, and 9th generation. Built-in screen protector and pop-out kickstand.
record.long_description: This protective case fits the 10.2 inch iPad models from the 2019, 2020, and 2021 releases, which the listing identifies as the 7th, 8th, and 9th generations. The outer shell is a solid polycarbonate backplate, designed to be rugged. The front has a built in screen protector that the seller says prevents scratches while keeping the touch screen responsive. A pop out kickstand lets the tablet stand up for watching shows and movies or for playing games. The cutouts are placed so that the ports, sensors, speakers, and cameras remain accessible. The case is pink. The Unicorn Beetle Pro Series name in the title identifies the product line. The listing does not state a warranty, dimensions, or the weight of the case, so check those details before buying if they matter to you.

record.description: A 10 litre semi-round step trash can in white steel with a stainless steel lid, plus a pack of 60 liners in code C. The lid is designed to close smoothly and quietly, and the inner bucket can be removed.
record.seo_title: simplehuman 10 Litre White Steel Step Can with Liners
record.meta_description: simplehuman 10 litre semi-round white steel step can with a stainless steel lid, removable inner bucket, and a set of 60 code C liners.
record.long_description: This trash can is a 10 litre step can with a semi-round body in white steel. Its lid is stainless steel and uses a damping mechanism that the listing calls lid shox technology, which helps it close smoothly and quietly. The steel pedal is described as strong, and the can has a removable inner bucket that makes emptying and cleaning easier. The listing says the can stays stable even when it holds a large amount of waste. The package also includes 60 liners in code C, which the seller says are designed to fit simplehuman trash cans. The title lists code C, so confirm that the code matches your can before buying. Because the listing focuses on the can's mechanics and the liner fit, check the dimensions and the manufacturer's care guidance before you buy, especially if space is tight.

specs.product: NFL New England Patriots long sleeve tee

record.description: A long sleeve tee with a relaxed fit, made of 100 percent ring-spun combed cotton with a slub texture. It has a ribbed collar, a tagless neckline, and distressed screen print graphics. The shirt is an officially licensed NFL product.
record.seo_title: OTS NFL Patriots Men's Slub Long Sleeve Tee
record.meta_description: OTS NFL New England Patriots slub long sleeve tee in XX-Large, made of 100 percent ring-spun combed cotton with a relaxed fit and distressed print.
record.long_description: This New England Patriots long sleeve tee is an officially licensed NFL product from OTS, a sports lifestyle brand sold on Amazon. The shirt is made from 100 percent ring-spun combed cotton, which the listing says gives a finer, softer, and more durable feel than a standard cotton tee. The slub yarn creates a textured surface, and the fabric is washed for a worn in look. The collar is ribbed, the neckline is tagless, and the side seams are part of the construction. The fit is relaxed with good drape. Distressed screen print graphics appear across the center chest and down one sleeve, and they are designed to flex with the fabric for a vintage feel. The listing offers this shirt in XX-Large, and the design is labeled Distressed Sinclair. The listing does not name a color, so review the product image for the shirt's color before buying.

record.description: A stretch bracelet with black beads and a burnished gold accent, handmade by the brand's in house designers. The listing says it is lead and nickel compliant and suited to parties, gifts, and special occasions.
record.seo_title: LUX Accessories Boho Gold Black Beaded Bracelet
record.meta_description: LUX Accessories boho stretch bracelet with black beads and a burnished gold look. Handmade, lead and nickel compliant, and a good gift for parties or occasions.
record.long_description: This stretch bracelet combines black beads with a burnished gold look in a boho free spirit style. The listing says the piece was handmade by in house designers and is meant as a gift for a woman or as a statement accessory for parties and family events. The brand states the bracelet is lead and nickel compliant with U.S. requirements, and it describes the materials as quality. Because it is a stretch design, it should slide onto the wrist without a clasp. The listing says the item is packaged with care and delivered across the state. It also mentions a 30 day satisfaction money back guarantee. The brand describes itself as a fashion accessories company with a design team in New York and manufacturing in China. The listing does not give a size, so check the sizing details on the product page before ordering.

specs.filters: Single and double dual wall baskets, double cup splitter

record.description: A semi-automatic 15 bar espresso machine with a 1450 watt heater, a steam wand for frothing milk, and a compact 5.5 inch body. It includes single and double filter baskets, plus a double cup splitter for brewing two cups at once.
record.seo_title: MICHELANGELO 15 Bar Espresso Machine with Frother
record.meta_description: MICHELANGELO semi-automatic espresso machine with a 15 bar pump, 1450 watt heater, steam wand, and a compact 5.5 inch body for home or office use.
record.long_description: This semi-automatic espresso machine is meant for home or office use, with a compact body that the listing says is about 5.5 inches wide. A 15 bar pump and 1450 watt heater preheat the machine and extract espresso, and the listing says a shot can be ready within about a minute. A knob selects the mode, while programmed buttons handle single or double shots. An adjustable steam wand lets you froth milk for cappuccino and latte drinks. The portafilter accepts two dual wall filter baskets, one for a single shot and one for a double, and a double cup splitter allows two cups to be brewed at once. The listing describes the machine as an entry level option with simple setup. Read the instructions before first use, and check the water tank and cleaning steps in the manual.

specs.type: Smart posture corrector with vibration reminder
specs.display: LED display for correction count and power

record.description: A wearable posture corrector with a vibration reminder and an LED display that counts correction events. It has a 500 mAh rechargeable battery, weighs about 85 grams, and is rated for users from 15 to 100 kilograms.
record.seo_title: Hiroumer Smart Posture Corrector with Vibration Reminder
record.meta_description: Hiroumer smart posture corrector with a vibration reminder and LED display, a 500 mAh rechargeable battery, and a range rated for 15 to 100 kilograms.
record.long_description: This posture corrector is a smart brace that uses a sensor to detect when the upper back bends forward and then gives a vibration reminder. The listing says a sensor and chip track posture, and the LED display shows the count of corrections along with the power level. The brace is made of soft nylon and ABS, and the strap can be adjusted to fit. A switch powers the unit on, and the seller says a few shakes confirm it is working. The battery is 500 mAh and charges through a standard V8 USB port, with the listing estimating about two hours for a full charge. The device weighs about 85 grams and is listed for users between 15 and 100 kilograms, for women and children. The seller explains that the unit is meant to support correct habits over time rather than force a fixed posture. If the device does not turn on, the listing suggests charging it for ten minutes before contacting the seller. Consult a health professional if you have back pain or a medical condition.

record.description: A pack of eight retractable gel pens with 0.7 mm bullet points, metal tips, and rubberized grips. The pens come in assorted bright ink colors for color coded notes, and the listing describes the writing as smooth and skip free.
record.seo_title: TUL Retractable Gel Pens, 0.7 mm, 8 Pack
record.meta_description: TUL retractable gel pens in an eight pack of assorted bright ink colors. Each pen has a 0.7 mm bullet point, a metal tip, and a rubberized comfort grip.
record.long_description: This eight pack of retractable gel pens comes in a range of bright ink colors, so you can assign a color to each category or topic in your notes. Each pen has a 0.7 mm bullet point, which the listing says makes bold and easy to read lines. The gel ink is described as smooth and skip free, and the metal tip is meant to give balance and precision while writing. Each pen has a retractable mechanism and a rubberized grip for comfort during longer writing sessions. The barrels are gray, while the ink colors are assorted. The pens are designed for everyday writing tasks, and the listing positions them as a way to keep important information easy to find. The set contains eight pens in total, so you have several options on hand when you need one.

specs.lid: Stainless steel lid with fire glass

record.description: A square propane fire pit with a hammered bronze finish, piezo ignition, and a stainless steel lid. Fire glass is included. The listing gives a heat rating of 40,000 to 42,000 BTU and runs on a 20 pound propane tank with a CSA regulator and hose.
record.seo_title: Hiland Square Propane Fire Pit, Hammered Bronze
record.meta_description: Hiland square propane fire pit with a hammered bronze finish, piezo ignition, a stainless steel lid, fire glass, and a CSA regulator and hose included.
record.long_description: This propane fire pit is square in shape with a hammered bronze finish. The listing gives a heat rating that varies between 40,000 and 42,000 BTU, and it runs on a standard 20 pound propane tank. An external piezo ignition lights the burner with a push, and the package includes a CSA regulator and hose. A stainless steel lid and fire glass come with the unit, and the product includes a thermocouple along with anti tilt safety devices. The listing presents the set as ready to connect, since the regulator and hose are included. Because it is a gas appliance, read the manual carefully before using it, follow local rules on outdoor flames, and keep the area clear of flammable materials. The model is GSF-PR-PC.

specs.compatibility: Physical and digital games that support handheld mode

record.description: A renewed Nintendo Switch Lite in coral, a handheld focused console with a small unibody design and a built in +Control Pad. The listing says it plays physical and digital Switch games that support handheld mode.
record.seo_title: Nintendo Switch Lite Coral, Renewed
record.meta_description: Renewed Nintendo Switch Lite in coral, a small unibody handheld with a built-in +Control Pad. Plays physical and digital games that support handheld mode.
record.long_description: This is a renewed Nintendo Switch Lite in a coral color. It is a handheld focused version of the Switch, with a sleek unibody design and integrated controls, including a built in +Control Pad. The listing describes it as a small and light system at a lower price than the standard Switch. It plays physical and digital games that support handheld mode, and the listing names popular titles such as Super Mario Odyssey, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. The listing describes renewed products as pre owned units that have been inspected and tested by Amazon qualified suppliers, with a full diagnostic test, replacement of defective parts, and a thorough cleaning. Packaging and accessories may be generic. The listing frames the system as optimized for personal, handheld play.

specs.compatibility: Humane Contain X-10 and related sonic and radio fence systems
specs.use: Multiple collars can be added to one system

record.description: A slim, waterproof, rechargeable collar that works as a multi-function receiver for the Humane Contain X-10 dog fence system and other compatible sonic and radio fence products. The battery recharges in about three hours.
record.seo_title: High Tech Pet RX-10 Multi-Function Dog Fence Collar
record.meta_description: High Tech Pet RX-10 waterproof multi-function collar for the Humane Contain X-10 dog fence and compatible systems. Rechargeable, with about three hour charging.
record.long_description: This collar is made to work with the Humane Contain X-10 electronic fence and several related containment systems, including Power Pet electronic doors, Sound Barrier and Yard Barrier sonic fences, and Radio Mat pet deterrent kits. The listing says a single RX-10 collar handles all of those functions, so a dog does not need several separate collars. Multiple collars can be added to one X-10 system to contain any number of dogs. The collar is described as extremely slim and lightweight, and the seller says it is waterproof and designed for comfort. The rechargeable battery is intended to last without replacement, and the listing says a recharge takes about three hours. Before buying, confirm that your fence or deterrent system matches the compatibility list in the listing. Read the fence system's manual for setup, boundary, and training instructions.

record.description: A 24 setting LED shower combo with an overhead head and a handheld shower. Seven colors change every few seconds, the lights run on water flow without batteries, and each head offers four spray settings with an air jet design.
record.seo_title: Luminex 24-Setting LED Shower Head Combo, 7 Colors
record.meta_description: Luminex LED shower combo with an overhead and handheld head, 24 spray patterns, and seven self changing colors powered by water flow. One year limited warranty.
record.long_description: This shower combo includes two LED heads, an overhead shower and a handheld shower, that can be used alone or together for 24 spray patterns. The lights are powered by water flow, so there are no batteries to replace, and seven colors change automatically and blend into one another. Each head has an oversized four inch face with four settings: rain, massage, rain with massage, and a water saving pause mode. Air jet technology mixes oxygen into the stream, and the listing says 48 rub clean nozzles help reduce clogging. Both heads are angle adjustable, and the handheld unit can be removed from its bracket for close up use. A patented three way water diverter with an anti swivel lock nut switches flow between the two heads. record.description: A canvas dog purse carrier from bellerata with an adjustable safety tether and a mesh window for airflow. It has a removable washable pad and several pockets for a wallet, phone, and pet supplies.

record.meta_description: GearLight XR98 100 LED UV black light flashlight for finding dried pet urine, bed bugs, and scorpions. Works in daylight and includes a lanyard.
record.long_description: This UV flashlight from GearLight uses 100 LEDs that emit a blacklight wavelength of 390 nm, designed to make certain stains and materials glow. It is aimed at finding dried dog urine on carpet, rugs, and furniture, and the listing says it can also help locate bed bugs, scorpions, leaks, and glow paint. The wide beam is said to work in daylight as well as in darker rooms, so complete darkness is not required. The listing says the flashlight does not detect wet stains or cat urine, and it will not work with new $100 bills. The aluminum body is described as durable and weather resistant. The package includes the flashlight, an AA battery holder, a lanyard, an operation guide, and a warranty card. Batteries are not included, and the listing says six AA batteries are required. The listing notes a patent for the LED design.

The metal is rated for oven temperatures up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. The pans are designed to stack, so they take up little cabinet space between uses. Cleaning is straightforward: you can rinse them or place them in the dishwasher, although hand washing is recommended if you want them to last longer. The set suits standard kitchen ovens, convection ovens, and toaster ovens, and it can also be used for serving or food prep. The two sizes are a practical pair for baking cookies in bulk batches.

record.seo_title: KILZ Premium High-Hide Latex Primer, White, 5 Gal
record.meta_description: KILZ Premium high-hide stain blocking latex primer and sealer in white, five gallons. Covers about 300 to 400 square feet per gallon and includes mildewcide.
record.long_description: KILZ Premium is a water-based latex primer and sealer designed to block stains and hide previous colors. The formula is meant to seal porous surfaces and fill small imperfections, leaving a smooth, level base for paint. It bonds to a range of materials, including drywall, plaster, woodwork, paneling, masonry, and brick, and the listing says it works on both interior and exterior surfaces. Mildewcide is built in to help resist mildew and mold growth, which makes the product practical for bathrooms and laundry rooms. The primer can help with color changes and can seal light to medium stains, though heavy stains may need a different product from the same brand, the KILZ Max primer. Coverage is listed at approximately 300 to 400 square feet per gallon. This five-gallon container gives a large supply for bigger projects. Check the label and the surface before applying, and follow the directions for ventilation and drying time.

specs.shielding: Front flap EMF shielding; listed as up to 99 percent
specs.testing: Listing cites FCC accredited lab testing

record.description: A black wallet-style phone case for the Galaxy S6 with EMF shielding built into the front flap. The listing says the shielding was lab tested and blocks up to 99 percent of cell phone radiation. The case includes RFID protection, space for up to four cards plus cash, and a built-in kickstand. It is made of vegan leather.
record.seo_title: SafeSleeve Galaxy S6 EMF Wallet Case, Black
record.meta_description: SafeSleeve black vegan leather wallet case for Galaxy S6 with EMF shielding in the front flap, RFID blocking, room for four cards, and a kickstand.
record.long_description: SafeSleeve's Galaxy S6 case combines a wallet and a phone cover, with a shielding layer in the front flap that the maker says blocks cell phone radiation. The listing cites testing by an FCC accredited laboratory and claims up to 99 percent blocking, and it describes the material as protective against RFID thieves. The wallet section holds up to four credit or business cards, with additional room for cash and documents. A built-in kickstand lets the phone rest upright for reading, video, or hands-free use on a flat surface. The case is made from vegan leather, which the seller says provides a professional look and is free of animal products. Black is the only color named in the listing. Because the shielding claims come from the seller, buyers who need verified protection should review the testing details the seller provides before relying on the product.

record.description: A women's performance running short in the Hydro Glitch Stripe pattern, in size 2X large. The wide waistband has an inner drawstring for adjustable fit, and an inner zip pocket holds small items. Hanes says its Cool Dry technology dries the fabric faster. The inseam is 3.5 inches.
record.seo_title: Hanes Women's Performance Run Short, 2X Large
record.meta_description: Hanes women's performance run short in Hydro Glitch Stripe, size 2X large. Cool Dry fabric, drawstring waistband, inner zip pocket, and a 3.5 inch inseam.
record.long_description: Hanes designed this women's performance run short for running and other active days. The Hydro Glitch Stripe pattern gives the short its distinctive look, and it is offered in 2X large. Cool Dry technology is built into the fabric to help it dry faster and keep the wearer comfortable. The waistband is wide and includes an inner drawstring, so the fit can be adjusted. A small zip pocket sits on the inside for stowing items while you move. The inseam measures 3.5 inches. Many people choose a short like this for running, gym sessions, or other training. The listing emphasizes quick drying and a comfortable waistband for everyday activity, so the short can serve as a regular piece in an active wardrobe. Check the size chart before ordering, since fit preferences differ among buyers.

record.description: A 20-foot tunable white LED strip with 720 LEDs that adjusts from 3000K warm white to 6000K daylight. A 360-degree RF remote controls color temperature and brightness, with 10 brightness levels, and the listing says it works through walls and cabinets. The strip is self-adhesive, can also be screwed in place, and is not waterproof.
record.seo_title: Novostella 20ft Tunable White LED Strip Light Kit
record.meta_description: Novostella 20-foot tunable white LED strip kit with 720 LEDs and an RF remote. Self-adhesive, for bedroom, kitchen, or cabinet lighting.
record.long_description: Novostella's kit gives you a 20-foot run of tunable white LED strip that moves between warm 3000K and daylight 6000K tones. The strip carries 720 LEDs of the 2835 type and runs on 24-volt DC power, with a 100 to 240 volt AC adapter. A 360-degree RF remote handles the color and brightness adjustments, offering ten brightness levels. The listing states that the remote has a range of about 40 to 45 feet and that its signal can pass through walls, doors, and cabinets. The strip has a self-adhesive backing, and the kit includes screws for a more secure mount. It also comes with brackets, a controller cable, and a UL-listed adapter. The product is not waterproof, so it is meant for dry indoor areas. The listing mentions a 50,000-hour lifespan and a 12-month warranty, though details should be confirmed with the seller.

specs.dimensions: 3-3/5 in L x 2-3/4 in W x 3-3/4 in H

record.description: A stainless steel dredge with a handle, holding up to 10 ounces of powder. The lid is perforated, so a few shakes dispense flour, sugar, or several kinds of spices. It measures 3-3/5 inches long, 2-3/4 inches wide, and 3-3/4 inches high.
record.seo_title: TableCraft 10-Ounce Stainless Steel Dredge
record.meta_description: TableCraft 10-ounce stainless steel dredge with a handle and perforated lid for flour, sugar, or spices. Measures about 3-3/5 by 2-3/4 by 3-3/4 inches.
record.long_description: The TableCraft dredge is a stainless steel shaker built for dusting food with flour, sugar, or spices. It holds up to 10 ounces and has a handle, so it can be held and tilted over a counter or pan. The lid is pierced with several holes, and the listing says that a few shakes are enough to dispense the powder. The body is made of stainless steel, which the maker describes as durable and long lasting. The unit measures about 3-3/5 inches long, 2-3/4 inches wide, and 3-3/4 inches tall. The listing describes it as a way to dispense powders like flour, sugar, and spices, with only a few shakes needed to complete the job. The listing does not describe cleaning instructions or dishwasher suitability, so check those details with the seller before purchase.

specs.compatibility: Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2, 40 mm

record.description: A five-pack of clear TPU screen protectors for the 40 mm Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2. The film has an oleophobic coating that the maker says resists fingerprints and dust. The listing claims about 99 percent clarity and says small scratches repair themselves within 24 hours. An installation video is included.
record.seo_title: UniqueMe Galaxy Watch Active 2 Screen Protector
record.meta_description: UniqueMe 5-pack clear TPU screen protectors for 40mm Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2, with fingerprint-resistant coating and self-healing film.
record.long_description: UniqueMe's screen protector set provides five clear TPU films sized for the 40 millimeter Samsung Galaxy Watch Active and Active 2. The film is designed to follow the curve of the display, which the listing says gives broader coverage on the edges. An oleophobic surface is meant to repel fingerprints and dust so the screen stays cleaner between wipes. The maker claims 99 percent HD clarity, aiming to keep colors and images bright. The film is described as self-healing, meaning small scratches and bubbles may smooth out automatically within about 24 hours. Installation instructions and a video are provided to guide the application. The listing also invites buyers to contact the company directly if a problem arises. Clean the watch screen thoroughly before application so the adhesive bonds well.

record.description: A wall-mounted hand towel bar made of 304 stainless steel, with two towel hooks included. It attaches with adhesive rather than screws and measures about 7.67 inches long, with a rated load of 11 pounds. The listing advises waiting 48 hours after installation before use, and it should go on clean, dry, smooth surfaces.
record.seo_title: Yosemy Hand Towel Holder with Hooks, Stainless
record.meta_description: Yosemy self-adhesive hand towel bar in 304 stainless steel with two towel hooks, no drilling needed. Holds up to 11 lb and needs 48 hours to set before use.
record.long_description: Yosemy's towel bar is a stainless steel holder for hand and dish towels, mounted with strong adhesive instead of drilled screws. It is made from 304 stainless steel, which the listing says resists rust and water, making it suitable for kitchens and bathrooms. The bar is about 7.67 inches long and is rated for a maximum load of 11 pounds. Two double hooks come with the set and can hold items such as hats, robes, keys, or razors, according to the listing. Because the mounting depends on adhesive, the wall surface must be flat, smooth, clean, and dry, and the listing notes that wallpaper and painted walls are not suitable. The instructions call for a 48-hour wait after installation before the bar is used. The bar can also be mounted on the side of a cabinet or closet door, as the listing describes.
